{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702465024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天體无窮，山高有限，遯之象也。嚴者，君子自守之常，而小人自不能近。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702465024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天下有山，山下。起而乃止，天上進而相違，是遯避之象也。君子觀其象以避遠乎小人。遠小人之道，若以惡聲厲色，適足以致其怨忿，惟在乎矜莊威嚴，使知敬畏，則自然遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702465024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"石氏介曰：不惡而嚴，外順而內正也。尚惡則小。人憎不嚴，則正道消。〇張子曰：惡讀爲憎惡之惡。遠小人不可示以惡也。惡則患及之，又焉能遠？嚴之爲言。敬小人而遠之之意也。○楊氏時曰：天下有山，其藏疾也無所拒，然亦終莫之陵也。此君子遠小人，不惡而嚴之。象也。○郭氏雍曰：君子當遯之時，畏小人之害，志在遠之而己。遠之之道何如？不惡其人而嚴其分是也。孔子。曰：疾之已甚，亂也。不惡則不疾矣。○俞氏琰曰：君子觀象以遠小人，豈有他哉？不過危行言遜而己。遜其言則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266636838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不惡，不使之怨也；危其行，則有不可犯之嚴，不使之不遜也。此君子遠小人之道也。案天下有山，以山喻小人，以天喻君子，似未切。蓋天下有山，山之高峻極於天也。山之高峻者，未嘗絶人，而自不可攀躋，故有不惡而嚴之象。楊氏之說，蓋是此意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遯尾之厲，不往何災也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702481408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702497792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見幾先遯，固爲善也。遯而爲尾，危之道也。往旣有危，不若不往而晦藏，可免於災，處危故也。古人處微下隱亂世而不去者多矣。案：程傳以不遯爲免災，朱子以晦處勿有所行爲免災，故朱子嘗欲劾韓𠈁胄，占得此爻而止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"執用黃牛，固志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702497792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266685990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702514176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上下以中順之道相固結，其心志甚堅，如執之以牛革也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702514176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"侯氏行果曰：上應貴主，志在輔。時不隨物遯，獨守中直，堅如革束，執此之志，莫之勝說。殷之父師，當此爻矣。○蔡氏淸曰：謂自固其志，不可榮。以祿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附録","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702530560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：固志者，堅固遯者之志，使不去己也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"係遯之厲，有疾，憊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702546944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畜臣妾吉，不可大事也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702563328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702579712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遯而有係累，必以困憊致危，其有疾乃憊也，蓋力亦不足矣。以此暱愛之心，畜養臣妾則吉，豈可以當大事乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702579712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張氏淸子曰：當遯而係，故有疾而厲，至於憊乏也。惟當以剛自守，止下二陰而畜之以臣。妾之道，然後獲吉，又豈可當大事乎？案不可大事，言未可直行其志，危言危行也。與彖小貞吉，大象不惡而嚴之意皆相貫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358511334752308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子好遯，小人否也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702596096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702612480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子雖有好而能遯，不失於義，小人則不能勝其私意，而至於不善也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702612480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：爻辭。云：好遯，君子吉，小人否。爻傳不及吉字，蓋謂惟君子爲能好遯，小人則不能好遯也。旣好遯，則遯而亨，其吉不假言矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘉遯貞吉，以正志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702628864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702645248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"志正則動必由正，所以爲遯之嘉也。居中得正而應中正，是其志正也，所以爲吉。人之遯也，止也，唯。在正其志而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702645248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：居正處中，能正其志，故獲貞吉。案君子之志，不在寵利，故進以禮而退以義，所謂正志也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358511334768692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥遯无不利，无所疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702661632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702678016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其遯之遠，无所疑滯也。蓋在外則己遠，无應則无累，故爲剛決无疑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702678016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"侯氏行果曰最。處外極，無應於內，心無疑戀，超世高舉，安時無悶，故肥遯无不利。〇趙氏汝楳曰：四陽之中，三係於陰，四五應於陰皆不能不自疑，至上則疑慮盡亡，蓋无有不利者矣。○李氏心傳曰：无所疑也。此及升之九三並言之此。決於退，彼決於進，時之宜耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷在天上。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702694400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大壯，君子以非禮弗履。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702710784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702727168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自勝者強。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702727168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷震於天上，大而壯也。君子觀大壯之象以行其壯。君子之大壯者，莫若克己。復禮。古人云：自勝之謂強。中庸於和而不流，中立而不倚，皆曰強哉！矯赴湯火，蹈白刃，武夫之勇可能也。至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690522146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"克己復禮，則非君子之大壯，不可能也。故云君子以非禮弗履。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702727168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：克己反禮，壯莫盛焉。○朱子語類云：雷在天上，是甚生威嚴。人之克己，須是如雷在天上，方能克去非禮。○項氏安世曰：君子所以養其剛。大者亦曰非禮勿履而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壯于趾，其孚窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702743552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702759936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言必窮困。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702759936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在最下而用壯以行，可必信其窮困而凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702759936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：居下而用壯，任剛而決行，信乎其窮而凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九二貞吉，以中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702776320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702792704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以貞正而吉者，以其得中道也。中則不失正，況陽剛而乾體乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702792704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：以其居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266702374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中履謙，行不違禮，故得正而吉也。案卦言大壯利貞，惟九二剛德則爲大，健體則爲壯，而居中則爲處壯之貞，乃卦之主也，故傳言以中明大壯。之貞，在於中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人用壯，君子罔也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702809088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702825472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小人以壯敗，君子以罔困。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702825472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在小人則爲用其強壯之力；在君子則爲用罔。志氣剛強，蔑視於事。靡所顧憚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702825472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：君子用罔，說者不同，然觀爻辭之例，如小人吉，大人否亨，君子吉。小人否，婦人吉，夫子凶。皆是相反之辭。又象辭曰：小人用壯，君子罔也。全與君子好遯，小人否也。句法相類。詩書中罔字與弗字、勿字、毋字通用，皆禁止之義也。〇楊氏簡曰：九三益進，勢雖壯，君子之心未嘗以爲意焉。唯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266718758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小人則自嘉己勢之壯，而益肄益壯，是謂小人用壯。罔，無也。言君子之所用，異乎小人之用也，故曰小人用壯。君子，罔也。○龔氏煥曰：大壯本以四陽盛長而得名，九三又以陽居陽而過剛，壯而又壯者也。用壯如此，是小。人之所爲，而非君子之道，故曰君子用罔。象釋之曰：小人用壮，君子罔也。語意與遯九四：君子好遯，小人否也。同。蓋遯之九四，卽大壯九三之反對，皆君子、小人並言。〇俞氏琰曰：孔子恐後世疑爻辭有兩用字，以爲小人。之用，與君子同，故特去其一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"藩決不羸，尚往也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702841856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702858240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剛陽之長，必至於極，四雖已盛，然其往未止也。以至盛之陽，用壯而進，故莫有當之。藩決開而不羸。困，其力也。尚往，其進不已也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702858240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：九四以剛居柔，有能正之吉，無過剛之悔，貞吉悔亡。四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266751526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"字旣盡之矣，又曰藩決不羸，壯于大輿之輹者，恐人以居柔爲不進也，故以尚往明之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喪羊于易，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702874624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702891008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以必用柔和者，以陰柔居尊位故也。若以陽剛中正得尊位，則下无壯矣。以六五位不當也，故設喪羊于易之義，然大率治壯不可用剛。夫君臣上下之勢，不相侔也。苟君之權足以制乎下，則雖有強壯跋扈。之人，不足謂之壯也。必人君之勢有所不足，然後謂之治壯。故治壯之道，不可以剛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702891008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏安石曰：剛柔者所以立本，變通者，所以趨時。方其趨時，則位正當而有咎凶，位不當而無悔者有矣。大壯之時得中。而處之以柔，能喪其很者也。案位當位不當，易例多借爻位以發明其德與時地之相當不相當也。此位不當，不止謂以陰居陽，不任剛壯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690538530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而已。蓋謂四陽已過矣，則五所處非當壯之位也。於是而以柔中居之，故爲喪羊于易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不能退，不能遂，不詳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702907392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艱則吉，咎不長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702923776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702940160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"非其處而處，故進退不能，是其自處之不詳愼也。艱則吉。柔遇艱難，又居壯終，自當變矣。變則得其分過咎不長，乃吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702940160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：臨六三，壯上六，皆无攸利，皆曰咎不長。蓋六三之憂，上六之艱，不貴無過，而貴改過也。○俞氏琰曰：人之處事，以爲易則不詳審，以爲艱則詳審。向也旣以不詳審而致咎，今詳審而不輕率，則其咎不長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明出地上，晉，君子以自昭明德。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702956544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702972928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昭明之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702972928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昭，明之也。傳曰：昭德塞違，昭其度也。君子觀明出地上而益明盛之象，而以自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358511334817844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昭其明德，去蔽致知，昭明德於己也。明明德於天下，昭明德於外也。明明德在已，故云自昭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702972928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：至健莫如天，君子以之自強；至明莫如日，君子以之自昭。○俞氏琰曰：明德，君子固有之德也。自昭者。自有此德而自明之也。人德本明，人欲蔽之，不能不少昏昧，其本然之明固未嘗息。知所以自明，則本然之明。如日之出地，而其昭著，初無增損也。大學所謂明明德，所謂自明，與此同旨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晉如摧如，獨行正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598702989312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"裕无咎，未受命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703005696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703022080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初居下位，未有官守之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703022080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"无進无抑，唯獨行正道也。寛裕則无咎者，始欲進而未當位，故。也。君子之於進退，或遲或速，唯義所當，未嘗不裕也。聖人恐後之人不達寛裕之義，居位者廢職失守以爲裕。故特云初六，裕則无咎者，始進未受命，當職任故也。若有官守不信於上而失其職，一日不可居也。然事非一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358598337282075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"槪久速唯時，亦容有爲之兆者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703022080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"劉氏曰：君子之於正，不可以人之不見知而攺其度。○張氏振淵曰：獨行正是原所以見摧之故。大凡君子處世，枉己易合，直道難容，惟正所以見摧，然安可因摧而自失其正正。與爻互相發明。案：未受命與臨九二同，臨、晉皆君子道長向用之卦也。然君子無急於乗勢趨時之意，當其臨也，至誠感物，如忘其勢，當其進也，守道優游，若將終身然，故一則曰未順命，一則曰未受命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受茲介福，以中正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703038464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703054848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"受兹介福，以中正之道也。人能守中正之道，久而必亨，況大明在上而同德，必受大福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703054848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏時曰：六二以柔順處乎衆陰，而獨無應，是不見知也，故晉如愁如。然。居中守正，素位而行，鬼神其福之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253274660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"詩曰：靖共爾位，好是正直。神之聽之，介爾景福。此之謂也。〇何氏楷曰：爾雅云：父之妣爲王母。小過六二遇妣。卽此言王母二五德同位應二受介福，以其履中得正也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆允之，志，上行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703071232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703087616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上行上順，麗於大明也。上從大明之君，衆志之所同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703087616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李氏過曰：初之罔孚，衆未允也。二之愁如，猶有悔也。三德孚於衆，進得所願而悔亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼫鼠貞厲，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703104000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703120384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"賢者以正德，宜在高位，不正而處高位，則爲非據，貪而懼失則畏人，固處其地，危可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703120384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陸氏希聲曰：履非其位，固其寵祿，鼫鼠之志，竊食黍稷而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358524395814975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失得勿恤，往有慶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703136768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703153152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以大明之德，得下之附，推誠委任，則可以成天下之大功，是往而有福慶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"維用伐邑，道未光也。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703169536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703185920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"維用伐邑，旣得吉而无咎，復云貞吝者，其道未光大也。以正理言之，尤可吝也。夫道旣光大，則无不中正，安有過也？今以過剛自治，雖有功矣，然其道未光大，故亦可吝。聖人言盡善之道。案道未光，乃推原所以伐邑之故，蓋進之極，則於道必未光也。如勢位重則有居成功之嫌，爵祿羈則失獨行。願之志，故必克治其私，然後高而不危，免於亢悔也。夬五之中，未光同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明入地中。","logicSentenceId":"7679310598703202304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明夷，君子以涖衆，用晦而明。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285419008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358598399885362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285435392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明所以照，君子无所不照。然用明之過，則傷於察，太察則盡事，而无含弘之度，故君子觀明入地中。之象，於涖衆也，不極其明察而用晦，然後能容物和衆，衆親而安，是用晦乃所以爲明也。若自任其明，无所不察，則已不勝其忿疾，而无寬厚含容之德，人情睽疑而不安，失涖衆之道，適所以爲不明也。古之聖人設前旒。屏樹者，不欲明之盡乎隱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285435392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：冕旒垂目，黈纊塞耳，無爲淸靜，民化不欺，若運其聰明。顯其智慧，民卽逃其密網，姦詐愈生，豈非藏明用晦，反得其明也。○張子曰：不任察而不失其治也。○林氏希元曰：用晦而明，不是以晦爲明，亦不是晦其明。蓋雖明而用晦，雖用晦而明也。用晦而明，只是不盡用其明。蓋盡用其明，則傷於太察，而无含弘之道。惟明而用晦，則旣不汶汶而暗，亦不察察而明，雖无所不照，而有不盡。照者，此古先帝王所以涖衆之術也。○何氏楷曰：晦其明，謂藏明於晦，晦而明謂生明於晦，意實相發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869253172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子于行，義不食也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285451776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285468160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"唯義所在，不食可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳、","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285468160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子遯藏而困窮，義當然也。唯義之當然，故安處而无悶，雖不食可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285468160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：義所不食，則于飛攸往，義所當行亦明矣，去之可不速乎？此伯夷、太公之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六二之吉，順以則也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285484544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285500928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六二之得吉者，以其順處而有法則也。則，謂中正之道。能順而得中正，所以處明傷之時，而能保其吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285500928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：明夷之下三爻，惟六二有救之之誠，上三爻惟六五無去之之心，皆中順之臣也。○王氏申子曰：以柔順處之，而不失其中正之則，昔者文王用明夷之道，其如是乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南狩之志，乃大得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285517312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266767910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285533696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫以下之明，除上之暗，其志在去害而已，如商、周之湯、武，豈有意於利天下乎？得其大首，是能去害。而大得其志矣。志苟不然，乃悖亂之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入于左腹，獲心意也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285550080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285566464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入于左腹，謂以邪僻之道入于君，而得其心意也。得其心，所以終不悟也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箕子之貞，明不可息也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285582848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285599232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"箕子晦藏，不失其貞固，雖遭患難，其明自存，不可滅息也。若逼禍患，遂失其所守，則是亡其明乃滅。息也。古之人如揚雄者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285599232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏軾曰：六五之於上六，正之則勢不敵，救之則力不能，去之則義。不可，此最難處者也，如箕子晦後可。箕子之處於此，身可辱也，而明不可息也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253307428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初登于天，照四國也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285615616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後入于地，失則也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285632000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285648384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"照四國，以位言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285648384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初登于天，居高而明，則當照及四方也，乃被傷而昏暗，是後入于地失明。之道也。失則失其道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285648384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：則者，不可踰之理。失則所以爲紂，順則所以爲文王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風自火出。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285664768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家人，君子以言有物而行有恆。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285681152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285697536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身脩則家治矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285713920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正家之本，在正其身。正身之道，一言一動，不可易也。君子觀風自火岀之。象知事之由內而出，故所言必有物，所行必有恆也。物謂事實，恆謂常度法則也。德業之著於外，由言行之謹。於內也，言愼行脩。則身正而家治矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285713920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：物，事也。言必有事，卽口無擇。言行必有常，卽身無擇行正家之義，脩於近小，言之與行，君子樞機，出身加人，發邇化遠，故舉言行以爲之誡。○楊氏時曰：言忠信。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690571298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則有物，行篤敬則有常。○胡氏炳文曰：風自火出，一家之化，自吾言行出，皆由內及外，自然薫蒸而成者也。〇俞氏琰曰：齊家之道，自脩身始，此風自火出，所以爲家人之象也。君子知風之自，於是齊家以脩身爲本而脩身以言行爲先，言必有物而无妄，行必有恆而不攺。物謂事實。言而誠實則有物，不誠實則無物也。恆謂常度。行而常久則有恆，不常久則無恆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閑有家，志未變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285730304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285746688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"志未變而豫防之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285746688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"閑之於始，家人志意未變動之前也。正志未流散變動而閑之，則不傷恩，不失義，處家之善也，是以悔亡。志變而後治，則所傷多矣，乃有悔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285746688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。蘇氏軾曰：忘閑焉則志變。矣，及其未變而閑之，故悔亡。○楊氏𥳑曰：治家之道，當防閑其初，及其心志未變而閑之以禮，邪僻之意無由。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253340196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而興矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六二之吉，順以巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285763072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285779456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二以陰柔居中正，能順從而卑巽者也，故爲婦人之貞吉也。案六二、六四之爲順同，順者，女之貞也。四位高，故曰順在位；二位卑，故曰順以巽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家人嗃嗃，未失也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285795840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦子嘻嘻，失家節也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285812224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285828608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖嗃嗃，於治家之道，未爲甚失。若婦子嘻嘻，是无禮法，失家之節，家必亂矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285828608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏弼曰：以陽處陽，剛嚴者也；處下體之極，爲一家之長者也。行與其慢，寧過乎恭，家與其瀆，寧過乎嚴。是以家人雖嗃。嗃，悔厲，猶得其道；婦子嘻嘻，乃失其節也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253356580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富家大吉，順在位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285844992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285861376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以巽順而居正位，正而巽順，能保有其富者也。富家之大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285861376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：禮運云：父子篤。兄弟睦，夫婦和，家之肥也，豈以多財爲吉哉？以順居之，則滿而不溢，可以保其家而長守其富，吉孰大焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王假有家，交相愛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285877760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285894144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"程子曰：夫愛其內助，婦愛其刑家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳：","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285894144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王假有家之道者，非止能使之順從而己，必致其心。化，誠合夫愛其內助，婦愛其刑家，交相愛也。能如是者，文王之妃乎！若身脩法立而家未化，未得爲假有家之道也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285894144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭氏雍曰：父父子子，兄兄弟弟，夫夫婦婦，同大。順而無逆焉者，交相愛之義也。〇龔氏煥曰：交相愛，則一家之父子兄弟、夫婦長幼，莫不相愛，非特夫婦而已也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358524395880511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"威如之吉，反身之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285910528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285926912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂非作威也。反身自治家之道，以正身爲本，治人程則畏傳服之矣，故云反身之謂。爻辭謂治家當有威嚴，而夫子又復戒云：當先嚴其身也。威嚴不先行於己，則人怨而不服，故云威如而吉者能自反。於身也，孟子所謂身不行道不行於妻子也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285943296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱氏震曰：威非外求，反諸身而己。反身則正，正則誠。誠則不怒而威，後世不知所謂威嚴者，正其身也。或不正而尚威怒，則父子相夷，愈不服矣，安得吉？○郭氏雍曰：象明言有物而行有常，而此又言反身之謂者，家人之道，所以成始成終者，脩身而己。○趙氏汝楳曰：爻於初言閑，三言嗃嗃，上言威，聖人慮後世以爲威嚴有餘，而親睦不足，故特釋之以反身。謂威如者，非嚴厲以爲威，反求諸己而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253372964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上火下澤。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285959680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睽，君子以同而異。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285976064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977285992448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二卦合體，而性不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286008832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上火下澤，二物之性違異，所以爲睽離之象。君子觀睽異之象於大同之中而知所當異也。夫聖賢之處世，在人理之常，莫不大同，於世俗所同者，則有時而獨異，蓋於秉彞則同。矣，於世俗之失則異也。不能大同者，亂常拂理之人也；不能獨異者，隨俗習非之人也。要在同而能異耳。中庸曰：和而不流，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286008832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荀氏爽曰：火性炎上，澤性潤下，故曰睽也。大歸雖同，小事當異，百官殊職，四民。異業，文武並用，威德相反，共歸於治，故曰君子以同而異也。〇項氏安世曰：同象兌之說，異象離之明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見惡人，以辟咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286025216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286041600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"睽離之時，人情乖違，求和合之，且病其不能得也。若以惡人而拒絶之，則将衆仇於君子，而禍咎至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869269556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣，故必見之，所以免避怨咎也。无怨咎，則有可合之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇主于巷，未失道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286057984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286074368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"本其正應，非有邪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286074368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當睽之時，君心未合，賢臣在下，竭力盡誠，期使之信合而己。至誠以感動之，盡力以扶持之，明義理以致其知，杜蔽惑以誠其意。如是，宛轉以求其合也，遇非枉道迎逢也，巷非邪。僻，由徑也，故夫子特云遇主于巷，未失道也。未，非必也。非必謂失道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286074368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：處上下睽離。之時，不得不委曲以求合，故曰未失道。言於正道未爲失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見輿曳，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286090752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无初有終，遇剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286107136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286123520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以六居三，非正也。非正則不安，又在二陽之閒，所以有如是艱戹，由位不當也。无初有終者，終必與。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358524395896895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上九，相遇而合，乃遇剛也。不正而合，未有久而不離者也。合以正道，自无終睽之理。故賢者順理而安行知者。知幾而固守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286123520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏瑗曰：无初有終，遇剛也者，言初爲上之見疑，然終則知己之誠而與之應，是六。三，所遇得剛明之人也。案：爻有兩喻，而象傳偏舉者，舉其重者也。此舉見輿曳，以乘剛也。困三舉據于蒺藜，亦以乗剛也。易例乗剛之危最甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交孚无咎，志行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286139904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286156288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初、四皆陽剛君子，當睽乖之時，上下以至誠相交，協志同力，則其志可以行，不止无咎而已。卦辭但言无咎，夫子又從而明之，云可以行其志，救時之睽也。蓋以君子陽剛之才，而至誠相輔，何所不能濟也？唯有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266817062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子則能行其志矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"厥宗噬膚，往有慶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286172672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286189056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻辭但言厥宗噬膚，則可以往而无咎，象復推明其義，言人君雖己才不足，若能信任賢輔，使以其道深入於己，則可以有爲，是往而有福慶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286189056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：二以五爲主，而委曲以入之，巷雖曲而通諸道：遇主于巷，将以行道，非爲邪也。五以二爲宗而親之，二五以中道相應，當睽之時，其閒也微而易合，如膚之柔，噬之則入，豈獨无咎，又将有慶。二五陰陽正應，故其辭如此。○何氏楷曰：厥宗旣噬膚矣，往則有相合。之慶，蓋決之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇雨之吉，羣疑亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286205440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358533266833446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286221824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雨者，陰陽和也。始睽而能終和，故吉也。所以能和者，以羣疑盡亡也。其始睽也，无所不疑，故云羣疑。睽極而合則皆亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286221824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：羣疑亡者，往與三合如雨，之和，向之見豕、見鬼、張弧之疑倂消釋矣，故曰羣疑亡也。〇王氏安石曰：上九睽極，有應而疑之。夫睽之極，則物有似是而非者，雖明猶疑，疑之已甚。則以無爲有，無所不至，況於不明者乎？上九，剛過中，用明而過者也，故其始不能無疑。〇朱子語類云：諸爻立象，聖人必有所據，非是白撰，但今不可考耳。到孔子方不說象，如見豕負塗，載鬼一車之類，孔子只說羣疑亡。也便見得上面許多皆是狐惑可疑之事而已。到後人解說，便多牽強。〇趙氏汝楳曰：怪力亂神，聖人所不語。而此卦言之甚詳，故聖人斷之曰疑。蓋心疑則境見，心明則疑亡。知此者，志怪之書可焚，無鬼之論可熄。○王氏申子曰：孤生於睽，睽生於疑。今羣疑旣亡，則睽而合，合而和，所以吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253389348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上有水。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286238208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇，君子以反身脩德。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286254592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286270976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山之峻阻，上復有水，坎水爲險陷之象，上下險阻，故爲蹇也。君子觀蹇難之象，而以反身脩德君子。之遇艱阻，必反求諸己而益自脩。孟子曰：行有不得者，皆反求諸已。故遇艱蹇，必自省於身有失而致之乎是。反身也，有所未善，則改之，无歉於心，則加勉，乃自脩其德也。君子脩德以俟時而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286270976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"呂氏大臨曰山。上有水，水行不利，不得其地，故蹇也。水行不得其地，猶君子之行不得於人，不得於人，反求諸己而已，故愛人。不親，反其仁；治人不治，反其知；禮人不荅，反其敬。〇朱子語類云：潘謙之書曰：蹇與困相似，致命遂志，反身脩。德亦一般，殊不知不然，象曰澤无水困，處困之極，事無可爲者，故只得致命遂志。若蹇則猶可進步，如山上之泉曲折多艱阻，然猶可行，故敎人以反身脩德。只觀澤无水困，與山上有水蹇二句，便全不同。〇項氏安世曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568955871271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"反身象艮之背，脩德象坎之勞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往蹇來譽，宜待也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286287360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286303744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"方蹇之初，進則益蹇，時之未可進也，故宜見幾而止，以待時可行而後行也。諸爻皆蹇，往而善來，然。則无出蹇之義乎？曰：在蹇而往則蹇也，蹇終則變矣。果上己有碩義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286303744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：往而行險，不如居。易以俟之爲宜也。〇龔氏煥曰：居止之初，去險尚遠，見險而卽止，彖傳之所謂知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王臣蹇蹇，終无尤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286320128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286336512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事雖不濟，亦无可尤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286336512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖艱戹於蹇時，然其志在濟君難，雖未能成功，然終无過尤也。聖人。取其志義，而謂其无尤，所以勸忠集藎也。說侯氏行果曰：二上應於五，五在坎中，險而又險，志在匡弼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358598399934514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"匪惜其躬，故曰王臣蹇蹇，匪躬之故。輔君以此，終无尤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往蹇來反，內喜之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286352896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286369280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内，在下之陰也。方蹇之時，陰柔不能自立，故皆附於九三之陽而喜愛之。九之處三，在蹇爲得其所。也。處蹇而得下之心，可以求安，故以來爲反，猶春秋之言歸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286369280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：內卦三爻，唯九三一陽。居二陰之上，是内之所恃，故云內喜之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往蹇來連，當位實也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286385664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286402048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四當蹇之時，居上位，不往而來，與下同志，固足以得衆矣。又以陰居陰，爲得其實，以誠實與下，故能連，合而下之，二三亦各得其實。初以陰居下，亦其實也。當同患之時，相交以實，其合可知，故來而連者當位以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690636834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"實也。處蹇難，非誠實何以濟？當位不曰正而曰實，上下之交，主於誠實用各，有其所也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286402048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荀氏爽曰：處正承陽，故曰當位實也。○沈氏該曰：四當位可進，而陰柔不能獨濟，來而承五，連於陽實，則得所輔也。○姜氏寶曰：以陰比於陽，陽爲實，故云傳以爲誠實之實，未然。案：荀氏、沈氏、姜氏之說皆是，然如此，則當位兩字，宜著九五說。言當尊位者，有實德也，如敵剛也之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大蹇朋來，以中節也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286418432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286434816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朋者，其朋類也。五有中正之德，而二亦中正，雖大蹇之時，不失其守。蹇於蹇以相應助，是以其中正。之節也，上下中正而弗濟者，臣之才不足也。自古守節秉義而才不足以濟者豈少乎？漢李固、王允、晉周顗、王導之徒是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286434816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：得位履中，不改其節，則同志者自遠而來，故曰朋來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690653218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案蹇卦之義，在乎進止得宜，爻之往來，卽進止也。九五雖不言往來，而傳明其爲中節，則進止之宜不失可以。濟難而不至於犯難矣。裴度云：朝廷處置得宜，有以服其心，其中節之謂乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往蹇來碩，志在內也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286451200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利見大人，以從貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286467584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286483968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上六，應三而從五，志在內也。蹇旣極而有助，是以碩而吉也。六以陰柔，當蹇之極，密近剛陽中正之君，自然其志從附，以求自濟，故利見大人，謂從九五之貴也。所以云從貴，恐人不知大人爲指五也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286483968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏軾曰：內與貴，皆五之謂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷雨作解。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286500352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以赦過宥罪。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286516736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286533120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天地解散而成雷雨，故雷雨作而爲解也。與明兩而作離語不同。赦，釋之，宥寬之，過失則赦之可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869335092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"罪惡而赦之，則非義也，故寬之而已。君子觀雷雨作解之象，體其發育則施恩仁，體其解散則行寬釋也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286533120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：赦謂放免，過謂誤失，宥謂寛宥，罪謂故犯，過輕則赦，罪重則宥，皆解緩之義也。〇趙氏汝楳曰：雷者天之威，雨者天之澤。威中有澤，猶刑獄之有赦宥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔之際，義无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286549504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286565888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初四相應，是剛柔相際接也。剛柔相際，爲得其宜。難旣解而處之，剛柔得宜，其義无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286565888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蔡氏淵曰：柔居解初，而承剛應剛，得剛柔交際之宜，難必解矣，故曰義无咎也。案初本以居最內，最後得來復之義，故无咎。孔子恐人謂其一無所爲也，故以從陽補其義在後之例與遯初同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074288166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九二貞吉，得中道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286582272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286598656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂貞吉者，得其中道也。除去邪惡，使其中直之道得行，乃正而吉也。案黃者，中也，矢者，直也。人臣之道，固主乎直，然直而不中，則有以嫉惡去邪而激成禍亂者多矣。得中道正釋得黃矢之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"負且乗，亦可醜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286615040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自我致戎，又誰咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286631424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286647808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"負荷之人，而且乗載，爲可醜惡也。處非其據，德不稱其器，則冦戎之致，乃己招取，將誰咎乎？聖人又於繫辭明其致冦之道，謂作易者其知盜乎？盜者乗釁而至，苟无釁隙，則盜安能犯？負者小人之事，乗者君子。之器。以小人而乗君子之器，非其所能安也，故盜乗釁而奪之；小人而居君子之位，非其所能堪也，故滿假而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298055195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陵慢其上，侵暴其下，盜則乗其過惡而伐之矣。伐者，聲其罪也。盜，橫暴而至者也。貨財而輕慢其藏，是敎誨乎？盜使取之也。女子而夭冶其容，是敎誨淫者使暴之也。小人而乗君子之器，是招盜使奪之也。皆自取之之謂。也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286647808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷氏思曰：負且乗，小人自以爲榮，而君子所耻，故可醜宼。小則爲盜，大則爲戎，任使非人則變。解而蹇，天下起戎矣。案雷氏說，極得此傳及繫傳之意。此傳所謂致戎，繫傳所謂盜斯伐之，皆謂有國家者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"解而拇，未當位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286664192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286680576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四雖陽剛，然居陰，於正疑不足，若復親比小人，則其失正必矣。故戒必解其拇，然後能來君子，以其處未當位也。解者，本合而離之也，必解拇而後朋孚，蓋君子之交而小人容於其閒，是與君子之誠未至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869351476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286680576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄭氏汝諧曰：四之所自處者不當，宜小人之所附麗也。必解去之，然後孚於其朋。朋，剛陽之類，拇在。下之陰。案德非中正，而應初比三，故曰未當位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子有解，小人退也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286696960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286713344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子之所解者，謂退去小人也。小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286713344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人去則君子之道行，是以吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286729728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"呉氏曰：愼曰：君子能有解，則少人退矣。小人若未退，則是君子未能解也。以小人之退，驗君子之解，雖不言有孚，而有孚之義明矣。案如鄭氏說，則須云君子果能有解，則雖小人亦信之，而回心易行，不待黜抑而自退矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公用射隼，以解悖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286729728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690685986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286746112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"至解終而未解者，悖亂之大者也。說射之，所以解之也，解則天下平矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286746112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吳氏曰：愼曰：天下之難由小人作，羣比如拇，邪媚如狐，鷙害如隼，解拇、獲狐、射隼而難解矣。故解卦以去小人爲要義。案五以前所解者，但總名之爲小人耳，此則曰悖，內亂、外亂之别也。在有虞則共驩者，內亂也；三苗者，外亂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山下有澤。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286762496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損，君子以懲忿窒欲。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286778880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286795264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子脩身，所當山下有澤，氣通上潤，與深下損者，莫切於此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286811648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以增高，皆損下之象，君子觀。損之象，以損於已，在脩己之道，所當損者唯忿與欲，故以懲戒其忿怒，窒塞其意欲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286811648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虞氏翻曰：兌說故懲忿，艮止故窒欲。〇孔氏穎達曰：懲者，息其旣往，窒者，閉其將來。懲、窒互文而相足也。〇楊氏時曰：損德之脩也，所當損者惟忿慾而已。故九思始於視聽貌、言，終於忿思難，見得思義者以此。○朱子語類問：何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298104347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"窒慾，伊川云：思此，莫是慾心一萌，當思禮義以勝之否？曰：然。〇王氏申子曰：和說則無忿，知止則無慾，故曰脩。德之要也。案凡大象配兩體之德者，皆先內後外，故當以虞氏之說爲是。益象亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已事遄往，尚合志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286828032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286844416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尚上通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286860800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：尚，上也。時之所崇用爲尚，初之所尚者，與上合志也。四賴於初，初益於四與上。合志也。案易例，初九與六四雖正應，却無往從之之義，在下位不援上也。惟損初爻言遄往，而傳謂上合志，蓋當損下。益上之時故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298120731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九二利貞，中以爲志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286877184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳、","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286893568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九居二，非正也；處說，非剛也，而得中爲善。若守其中德，何有不善？豈有中而不正者？豈有中而有過？者二，所謂利貞，謂以中爲志也。志存乎中，則自正矣。大率中重於正，中則正矣，正不必中也，能守中，則有益於上矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286893568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：言九二所以能居而守貞，不損益之，良由居中，以中爲志，故損益得其節適也。〇王氏宗傳曰：順從爲事，則在己者所損多矣，以道自守，乃所以益之，故曰九二利貞，中以爲志也。中以爲志，則在己者無失，而益上之實，亦無出諸此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一人行，三則疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286909952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286926336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一人行而得一人，乃得友也。若三人行，則疑所與矣，理當損去其一人，損其餘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869367860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案自二以上，皆可以三概之，不必正三人也。季文子三思、南容三復之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損其疾，亦可喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286942720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286959104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"損其所疾，固可喜。也云亦發語辭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286959104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏：安世曰：能不吝其疾，自損以受之，使合志者得。效其忠，豈非可喜之事哉？案易多言有喜，而此傳云亦可喜也。則此喜不主己身，乃主於使遄來而益我者有喜，故變文曰可喜者他人。之辭也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六五元吉，自上祐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286975488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977286991872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以得元吉者，以其能盡衆人之見，合天地之理，故自上天降之福祐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568955920423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案自上祐以爲正，釋龜筮弗違亦可。然觀益二言朋龜不違，下又云享于帝吉，則帝者又百神之主也，故此上祐，亦是言天心克享，人神不能違也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弗損益之，大得志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977287008256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679311977287024640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居上不損下而反益之，是君子大得行其志也。君子之志，唯在益於人而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風雷益，君子以見善則遷，有過則改。","logicSentenceId":"7679311977287041024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風雷之勢，交相助益，遷善攺過，益之大者而相其益亦猶是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風烈則雷迅，雷激則風怒。二物相益者也。君子觀風雷相益之象，而求益於己。爲益之道，无若見善則遷，有過則改也。見善能遷，則可以盡天下之善，有過能改，則无過矣。益於人者，无大於是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010465314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏弼曰：遷善攺過，益莫大焉。〇胡氏炳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298137115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文曰：雷與風自有相益之勢。速於遷善，則過當益寡，決於改過，則善當益純，是遷善、改過，又自有相益之功也。〇蔣氏悌生曰：風雷相益，迅速不遲，君子法之，見善則卽遷，知過必速改，不可猶豫。〇何氏楷曰：咸言速心之。德通於虛也。不損不虛，懲忿窒欲，損之又損，致虛以復，其爲咸、恆。言久心之德凝於實也。不益不實，遷善改過。益之又益，充實而成其爲恆。案雷者，動陽氣者也，故人心奮發而勇於善者如之。風者，散陰氣者也，故人心蕩滌以消其惡者如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元吉无咎，下不厚事也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010481698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下本不當任厚事，故不如是，不足以塞咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在下者本不當處厚事，厚事，重大之事也。以爲在上所任，所以當大事，必能濟大事而致元吉，乃爲无咎。能致元吉，則在上者任之爲知人，己當之爲勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298153499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"任，不然，則上下皆有咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010498082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄭氏汝諧曰：得益者，非以是而自私也。故損之上，利有攸往，得臣无家。益。之初，利用爲大作。爲大作者，當爲大益之事也。然在下而爲大益之事，位未崇也，誠未孚也，必元吉然後无咎。以其位非厚事之地也。〇朱子語類云：利用大作。象曰：下不厚事也。自此推之，則凡居下者不當厚事，如子之於父，臣之於君，僚屬之於官長，皆不可以踰分越職，縱可爲，亦須是盡善，方能無過，所以有元吉无咎之戒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或益之，自外來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010514466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010530850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或者衆无定主傳辭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010530850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣中正虛中，能受天下之善而固守，則有有益之事。衆人自外來益之矣。或曰：自外來，豈非謂五乎？曰：如二之中正，虚中，天下孰不願益之？五爲正應，固在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010530850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏。穎達曰：自外來者，明益之者從外而來，不召而至也。〇楊氏簡曰：或益之，自外來也，亦猶損六五之或益之，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690718754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上，祐也。皆言本無求益之意，而益自至也。曰自外來，言非中心之所期，自外而至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"益用凶事，固有之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010547234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010563618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"益用凶事，欲其困心。衡慮而固有之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010563618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：六三益之，獨可用於凶。事者，以其固有之也謂。專固自任其事也。居下當稟承於上，乃專任其事，唯救民之凶災，拯時之艱急則可也，乃處急難變故之權宜。故得无咎，若平時則不可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010563618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：益之以凶事，雖曰災自外來，而已，乃受益，乃其已分之所。固有者，非自外來也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"告公從，以益志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010580002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010596386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻辭但云得中行，則告公而獲從，象復明之曰：告公而獲從者，告之以益天下之志也。志苟在於益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568955936807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天下上必信而從之，事君者不患上之不從，患其志之不誠也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010596386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：六四之告公以益民爲志。故得見從也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有孚惠心，勿問之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010612770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惠我德，大得志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010629154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010645538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人君有至誠惠益天下之心，其元吉不假言也，故云勿問之矣。天下至誠，懷吾德以爲惠，是其道大。行，人君之志得矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說：","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010645538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"崔氏憬曰：損上之時，一以損己爲念，雖有孚惠心及下，終不言以彰己功，故曰有孚惠心勿問。問，猶言也。如是獲元吉，且爲下所信而懷己德，故曰有孚惠我德。君雖不言，人惠其德則我大。得志也。〇張氏振淵曰：惠出於心，又何問焉？大得志，非以民之惠我爲得志，以我足以致民惠我爲得志也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫益之，偏辭也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010661922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或擊之，自外來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010678306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074320934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"莫益之者，猶從其求益之偏辭而言也。若究而言之，則又有擊之者矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"理者，天下之至。公利者，衆人所同欲。茍公其心，不失其正理，則與衆同利，无侵於人，人亦欲與之。若切於好利，蔽於自私，求自益以損於人，則人亦與之力爭，故莫肯益之，而有擊奪之者矣。云莫益之者，非其偏己之辭也。苟不偏己，合於公道，則人亦益之，何爲擊之乎？旣求益於人，至於甚極，則人皆惡而欲攻之，故擊之者自外來也。人爲善則千。里之外應之。六二中正虚己，益之者，自外而至是也。茍爲不善，則千里之外違之。上九求益之極，擊之者自外。而至是也。繫辭曰：君子安其身而後動，易其心而後語，定其交而後求。君子脩此三者，故全也。危以動，則民不與也。懼以語，則民不應也；无交而求，則民不與也。莫之與，則傷之者至矣。易曰：莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。君。子言動與求，皆以其道，乃完。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010694690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：二，不求善也，不然，則取傷而凶矣。益而或益之，自外來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690751522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。上求益而或擊之，亦自外來也，孰有以來之？五之吉，由中心之有孚；上之凶，由立心之勿恆，吉凶之道未有。不自心生者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤上於天。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010711074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夬。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010727458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以施祿及下，居德則忌。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010743842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010760226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤上於天，潰決之勢也。施祿及。下，潰決之意也。居德則忌，未詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010776610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤，水之聚也而上於天，至高之處，故爲夬象。君子觀澤決於上而注漑於下之象，則以施祿及下，謂施其祿澤以及於下也。觀其決潰之象則以居德則忌。居德，謂安處其德，則約也。忌，防也。謂約立防禁，有防禁則无潰散也。王弼作明忌，亦通，不云。澤在天上，而云澤上於天，上於天則意不安，而有決潰之勢。云在天上，乃安辭也。案澤上於天，所謂稽天之浸也，必潰決無疑矣。財聚而不散，則悖出，故君子以施祿及下，居身無所畏忌，則滿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358543253471268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而溢。故君子之居德也，則常存畏忌而己。禮曰：積而能散，書曰：敬忌而罔有擇言在躬。夫如是，則何潰決之患？之有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不勝而往，咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010792994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
