{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010809378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人之行，必度其事可爲，然後決之，則无過矣。理不能勝而且往，其咎可知。凡行而有咎者，皆決之過也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010809378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：謂非往之爲咎，不能度其可勝，而後往之爲咎也。○谷氏家杰曰：夬之道，其危乃光勝心不可有也，況不勝而往乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有戎勿恤，得中道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010825762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010842146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"莫夜有兵戎，可懼之甚也。然可勿恤者，以自處之善也。旣得中道，又知惕懼，且有戒備，何事之足恤？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869400628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。九居二，雖得中，然非正，其爲至善，何也？曰：陽決陰，君子決小人而得中，豈有不正也？知時識勢，學易之大方。也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010842146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：能得中道，故剛而不暴。○蘇氏軾曰：能靜而不忘警，能警而不用，得中道矣。與大壯九二貞吉同，故皆稱其得中。案有戎勿恤者，謂不輕於卽戎也，此所以爲得中道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子夬夬，終无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010858530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010874914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"牽梏於私好，由无決也。君子義之與比，決於當決，故終不至於有咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010874914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黃氏淳耀曰：終對始言之，始雖若濡有慍，終必決去而无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其行次且，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010891298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聞言不信，聰不明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010907682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593120895030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010924066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九，處陰，位不當也。以陽居柔，失其剛決，故不能強進，其行次且。剛然後能明，處柔則遷，失其正性，豈復有明也。故聞言而不能信者，蓋其聰聽之不明也。案四與陰尚隔，位不當者，借爻位以明四之未當事任，而欲次且前進之非宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中行无咎，中未光也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010940450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010956834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"程傳備矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010956834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦辭言夬夬，則於中行爲无咎矣。象復盡其義，云：中未光也。夫人心正意誠，乃能極中正之道，而充實光輝。五心有所比，以義之不可而決之，雖行於外，不失中正之義，可以无咎。然於中道未得爲光大也。蓋人心一有所欲，則離道矣。夫子於此示人之意深矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010956834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：陽近於陰，不能無累，故必正其行，然後免咎。〇趙氏汝楳曰：他卦貴於中行，此爻乃止於无咎，其亦體兌之說溺於上而致然乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568955985959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故於中爲未光也。案：張子之說極是，蓋因中未光，故貴於中行，非謂雖中行而猶未光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无號之凶，終不可長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010973218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136010989602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽剛，君子之道進而益盛，小人之道旣已窮極，自然消亡，豈復能長久乎？雖號咷，无以爲也，故云終。不可長也。先儒以卦中有孚號、惕號，欲以无號爲无號，作去聲，謂无用更加號令，非也。一卦中適有兩去聲字。一平聲字何害？而讀易者率皆疑之。或曰：聖人之於天下，雖大惡，未嘗必絶之也。今直使之无號，謂必有凶，可。乎？曰：夬者，小人之道消亡之時也。決去小人之道，豈必盡誅之乎？使之變革，乃小人之道亡也，道亡，乃其凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天下有風，姤，后以施命誥四方。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011005986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358540690767906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011022370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風行天下，无所不周。爲君后者，觀其周徧之象，以施其命令，周誥四方也。風行地上，與天下有風，皆爲周徧庶物之象。而行於地上，徧觸萬物，則爲觀，經歷觀省之象也。行於天下，周徧四方，則爲姤，施發命令之象也。諸象或稱先王，或稱后，或稱君子、大人。稱先王者，先王所以立法制，建國作樂，省方敕法，閉關育物，享帝。皆是也。稱后者，后王之所爲也，財成天地之道，施命誥四方是也。君子則上下之通稱，大人者，王公之通稱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011022370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：天下有風，姤與風行地上觀相似，故在姤則曰施命誥四方，在觀則曰省方觀民設敎。曰施曰誥，自上而下，天下有風之象也。曰省曰觀，周歷徧覽，風行地上之象也。案巽之申命，因有積獘而振飭之也。姤之施命，與巽正同，蓋在三畫之卦爲巽者，在六畫之卦卽爲姤也。施命申命，所以消隱慝，除積獘，法風之吹散伏陰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593120911414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"繫于金柅，柔道牽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011038754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011055138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"牽，進也。以其程進，故止之。傳牽者，引而進也。陰始生而漸進，柔道方牽也。繫之于金柅，所以止其進也，不使進，則不能消正道，乃貞吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011055138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：柔道牽者，陰柔之道，必須有所牽繫也。○鄭氏汝諧曰：此羸豕也，力雖微，而其志則蹢躅。惟信其蹢躅，則不可不有所牽制，故曰柔道牽也。○趙氏汝楳曰：姤之初，言繫言牽，惡陰之長而止之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"包有魚，義不及賓也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011071522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011087906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二之遇初，不可使有二於外，當如包苴之有魚。包苴之魚，義不及於賓客也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011087906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吳氏曰：愼。曰：九二旣包有魚，則當盡其防制之責。以義言之，不可使遇於賓也。若不制而使遇於賓，則失其義矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298186267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其行次且，行未牽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011104290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011120674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其始志在求遇於初，故其行遲遲，未牽不促。其行也，旣知危而攺之，故未至於大咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011120674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭氏雍曰：无膚次且之厲，蓋未嘗牽勉而妄行焉，是以至此。案易中言牽者，自小畜至此，皆當爲牽制之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无魚之凶，遠民也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011137058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011153442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"民之去己，猶己遠之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011153442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下之離，由己致之。遠民者，己遠之也，爲上者有以使之離也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011153442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余氏本曰：言其使民失道，無以結民之心，致民之去己，由己之遠乎民也。案九四因與陰相應，故惡而欲遠之，正如夬三壯于頄之意。徒欲遠之而不能容之制之，此所以包无魚也。君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593120927798"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子之於小人也，惟其能容之，是以能制之；不能容之，則彼自絶矣，欲以力制，不亦難乎？書曰：民可近，不可下此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九五含章，中正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011169826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有隕自天，志不舍命也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011186210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011202594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂含章，謂其含藴中正之德也。德充實則成章而有輝光。命，天理也。舍，違也。至誠中正，屈己求賢。存志，合於天理，所以蘇氏軾曰：陰長而消陽，天之有隕，自天必得之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011202594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命也，有以勝之，人之志也。君。子不以命廢志，故九五之志堅，則必有自天而隕者，言人之至者，天不能勝也。〇楊氏啟新曰：陰陽迭勝，天運。自然而心心念念，不舍天命，以靜制之，此所以挽回造化也。案詩云：桑之落矣，其黃而隕。故有隕自天，謂天時旣至，而瓜隕也。雖天命之必然，亦由君子積誠脩德與之符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956018727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"會，故曰志不舍命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"姤其角，上窮，吝也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011218978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011235362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣處窮上，剛亦極矣，是上窮而致吝，也。以剛極居高而求遇，不亦難乎？案：不與陰遇，雖无咎，然君子終以不能濟時爲可羞，爲其身在事外，所處之窮故爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤上於地。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011251746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萃，君子以除戎器，戒不虞。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011268130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011284514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"除者，脩而聚之之謂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011284514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤上於地，爲萃聚之象。君子觀萃象，以除治戎器，用戒備於不虞。凡物之萃則有不虞度之事，故衆聚則有爭，物聚則有奪，大率旣聚則多故矣，故觀萃象而戒也。除，謂簡治也。去。獘，惡也，除而聚之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011284514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏弼曰：聚而無防，則衆生心，所以戒不虞也。〇朱子語類云：大凡物聚衆盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593120944182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"處必有爭，故當豫爲之備。又澤本當在地中，今却上於地上，是水盛有潰決奔突之憂，故取象如此。〇王氏申子曰：澤上有地，臨則聚澤者，地岸也；澤上於地，萃則聚澤者，隄防也。以地岸而聚澤，則無隄防之勞；以隄防而聚澤則有潰決之憂，故君子觀此象，爲治世之防，除治其戎器，以爲不虞之戒。若以治安而忘戰守之備，則是。以舊防爲無用而壞之也，其可乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃亂乃萃，其志亂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011300898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011317282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其心志爲同類所惑亂，故乃萃於羣陰也。不能固其守，則爲小人所惑亂，而失其正矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011317282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李氏𥳑曰：非其志惑亂，必無舍應亂萃之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"引吉无咎，中未變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011333666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074353702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011350050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萃之時，以得聚爲吉，故九四爲得上下之萃。二與五雖正應，然異處有閒，乃當萃而未合者也，故能相引而萃，則吉而无咎，以其有中正之德，未據至改變也。變則不相引矣。或曰：二旣有中正之德，而象云未變。辭若不足，何也？曰：羣陰比處，乃其類聚。方萃之時，居其閒，能自守不變，遠須正應，剛立者能之。二陰柔之才，以其有中正之德，可覬其未至於變耳，故象含其意以存戒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011350050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"說楊氏萬里曰：中未變者，蓋六二所守。之中道，不以爲上所引而有所變也。案此中未變，與比二不自失之意同，中庸所謂不變塞焉，孟子所謂達不離道者是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往无咎，上巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011366434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011382818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上居柔說之極，三往而无咎者，上六巽順而受之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011382818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，虞氏翻曰：動之四，故上巽。〇鄭氏汝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956035111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"諧曰：下二陰皆萃於陽矣，三獨無附，故咨嗟怨嘆而无攸利。雖然當萃之時，下欲萃於上，上亦欲下之萃於我。三不以無應之故，能往歸於上，雖小吝而亦可以无咎。上非上六，謂在上之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉无咎，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011399202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011415586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以其位之不當，疑其所爲未能盡善，故云必得大吉，然後爲无咎也。非盡善，安得爲大吉乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011415586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏軾曰：非其位而有聚物之權，非大吉則有咎矣。○郭氏雍曰：四得上下之聚，而非君位，故言不當也。○鄭氏汝諧曰：其位近，其德同，其爲下之所歸亦同，自非所爲至善，則其君病之，烏能无咎？戒之也。凡言位不當，其義不一。此所謂不當者，爲其以剛陽迫近其君也。○熊氏良輔曰：九四、九五皆萃之主，九五在上之萃也。九四，在下之萃也，故九五曰萃有位，而四象曰位不當，大吉无咎者，上比於君，以臣而有君萃之象，疑於有咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869498932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"故也。案鄭氏謂凡言位不當，其義不一者，是已。然須知是借爻位之當不當，以發明其德與時位之當不當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萃有位，志未光也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011431970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011448354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未光，謂匪孚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011448354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"象舉爻上句，王者之志，必欲誠信著於天下，有感必通，含生之類，莫不懷歸，若尚有匪孚，是其志之未光大也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011448354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：五，有其位者也。徒有其位，故人或匪孚，此志之所以未光也。〇胡氏炳文曰：四必大吉而後无咎，位不當也。五有位矣，而匪孚，志猶未光也。然則欲當天下之萃者，不可無其位，有其位，又不可無其德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"齎咨涕洟，未安上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011464738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625298219035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011481122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小人所處，常失其宜，旣貪而從欲，不能自擇安地，至於困窮，則顚沛不知所爲。六之涕洟，蓋不安於處上也。君子愼其所處，非義不居，不幸而有危困，則泰然自安，不以累其心。小人居不擇安，常履非據，及其窮。迫則隕𮒗躁撓，甚至涕洟，爲可羞也。未者，非遽之辭，猶俗云未便也。未便能安於上也。陰而居上，孤處无與，旣非其據，豈能安乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011481122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"趙氏光大曰：言危懼而不敢自安，於能安乎？上操心危，慮患深，安得晏然而已乎？案上，猶外也，雖在外而不敢自安，如舜之耕歷山，周公之處東國，必號泣嘵嘵，求萃於君父而後已也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地中生木。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011497506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"升，君子以順德，積小以高大。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011513890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011530274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王肅本順作愼。今案他書引此，亦多作愼，意尤明白，蓋古字通用也。說見上篇蒙卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011530274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木生地中長而上升，爲升之象。君子觀升之象，以順脩其德，積累微小，以至高大也。順則可進，逆乃退也。萬物之進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380798479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆以順道也。善不積不足以成名，學業之充實，道德之崇高，皆由積累而至，積小所以成高大，升之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011530274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：木之生也，一日不長則枯；德之進也，一息不愼則退。必念念謹審，事事謹審，其德積小高大。當如木之升矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"允升大吉，上合志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011546658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011563042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與在上者合志同升也。上謂九二，從二而升，乃與二同志也。能信從剛中之賢，所以大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011563042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"呂氏大臨曰：初六以柔居下，當升之時，柔進而上，雖處至下，志與三陰同升，衆之所允，無所不利，故曰允升大。吉。案呂氏以上爲上體三陰者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380814863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九二之孚，有喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011579426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011595810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二能以孚誠事上，則不唯爲臣之道无咎而已，可以行剛中之道，澤及天下，是有喜也。凡象言有慶。者，如是則有福慶及於物也。言有喜者，事旣善而又有可喜也。如大畜童牛之梏，元吉。象云有喜。蓋梏於童則易，又免強制之難，是有可喜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"升虚邑，无所疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011612194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011628578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入无人之邑，其進无疑阻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011628578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏軾曰：九三以陽用陽，其升也果矣，故曰升，虛邑无所。疑也。不言吉者，其爲禍福未可知也，存乎其人而己。案：乾四曰：或之者，疑之也，故无咎。果於進而无所疑，可乎？蘇氏之說善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869531700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王用亨于岐山，順事也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011644962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011661346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以順而升，登四居近君之位，而當升時，得吉，祭於山象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011661346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之而无咎者，以其有順德也。以柔。居坤，順之至也。文王之亨于岐山，亦以順時而己。上順於上，下順乎下，己順處其義，故云順事也。案用賢以享於神明，是順神明之心而事之者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貞吉升階，大得志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011677730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011694114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"倚任賢才，而能貞固，如是而升，可以致天下之大治，其志可大得也。君道之升，患无賢才之助爾。有助則猶自階而升也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011694114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何氏楷曰：卽彖所謂有慶志行者也。案自初而升，至此而升極矣，故初曰上合志，此曰大得志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869564468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冥升在上，消不富也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011710498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011726882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昏冥於升，極上而不知已，唯有消亡，豈復有加益也？不富，无復增益也。升旣極，則有退而无進也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011726882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏瑗曰：上六旣不達存亡之幾，以至於上位，固當消虚自損，不爲尊大，以自至於富盛也。案：胡氏之說善矣。然不曰不息之貞，消不富也，而曰冥升在上者，以在上明其位勢之滿盛，故當以自消損爲。貞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤无水。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011743266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011759650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以致命遂志。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011776034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011792418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水下漏則澤上枯，故曰澤无水。致命，猶言授命，言持以與人而不之有也。能如是，則雖困而亨矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011808802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤无水，困乏之象也。君子當困窮之時，旣盡其防慮之道，而不得免，則命也，當推致其命，以遂其志。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358560869548084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"知命之當然也，則窮塞禍患，不以動其心，行吾義而己。苟不知命，則恐懼於險難，隕穫於窮戹，所守亡矣，安能遂其爲善之志乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011808802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏弼曰：澤无水，則水在澤下，水在澤下，困之象也。處困而屈其志者，小人也。君子固窮，道可忘乎？○鄭氏汝諧曰：知其不可求，而聽其自至焉，致命也。在命者不可求，在志者則可遂，所謂從吾所好也。○馮氏當可曰：君子之處困也，命在天而致之，志在我則遂之。困而安於困者，命之致也。困而有不困者，志之遂也。若小人處之，則凡可以求幸免者，無不爲也，而卒不得免焉，則亦徒喪其所守而己矣。體坎。險以致命，體兌說而遂志。○何氏楷曰：致，猶委也。人不信其命，則死生禍福，營爲百端，居貞之志，何以自遂？今一委之命，則不以命貳志者，夫且能以志立命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入于幽谷，幽不明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011825186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611674857507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011841570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"幽，不明也，謂益入昏暗，自陷於深困也。明則不至於陷矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困于酒食，中有慶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011857954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011874338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖困於所欲未能施惠於人，然守其剛中之德，必能致亨而有福慶也。雖使時未亨通，守其中德，亦君子之道，亨，乃有慶也。案二有中德，故能以酒食享祀而有福慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據于蒺藜，乗剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011890722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入于其宫，不見其妻，不祥也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011907106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011923490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"據于蒺藜，謂乗九二之剛，不安猶藉刺也。不祥者，不善之徵，失其所安者，不善之效，故云不見其妻。不祥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011939874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄭氏汝諧曰：進阨於四，故困于石；退乗二之剛，故據于蒺藜。上其宫也。其宮可入而以柔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074386470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇柔，非其配也。以此處困，不祥莫甚焉。案爻有衆喻，而傳偏舉一者，舉其重者也。易乗剛之義最重，故睽三見輿曳，此爻據于蒺藜，皆以其乗剛言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來徐徐，志在下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011956258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖不當位，有與也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011972642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011989026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四應於初而隔於二，志在下求，故徐徐而來。雖居不當位，爲未善，然其正應相與，故有終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312136011989026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。蘇氏濬曰：四與五同爲上六所掩，進而見掩，豈君子直遂之時耶？惟沈濳以養其晦，從容以俟其幾，故五。曰乃徐，四曰徐徐，志在下者。四位雖上而心則下也。然四五合德，天下之事終以舒徐濟之，故曰有與，又曰有。終○何氏楷曰：五爲近比，則四之所與者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劓刖，志未得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012005410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃徐有說，以中直也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012021794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利用祭祀，","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012038178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358625516060682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012038178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012054562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"始爲陰揜，无上下之與，方困未得志之時也。徐而有說，以中直之道，得在下之賢，共濟於困也。不曰中正與二合者，云直乃宜也。直比正意差緩，盡其誠意，如祭祀然，以求天下之賢，則能亨天下之困，而享受其福慶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012054562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陸氏希聲曰：困，窮而通，德辨而明，中。正道行志則大遂，故乃徐有說也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困于葛藟，未當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012070946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動悔有悔，吉行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312136012087330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205841955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲困所纏而不能變，未得其道也，是處之未當也。知動則得悔，遂有悔而去之，可出於困，是其行而吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205841955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，陸氏希聲曰：行而獲吉，故曰變乃通也。〇田氏疇曰：諸家皆以吉行也三字爲一句，非也。蓋動悔有悔，吉，是句，行也是句，動悔。有悔之所以吉者，以能行而得之也。行也二字，乃是解征吉之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611674890275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木上有水。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205858339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井，君子以勞民勸相。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205874723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205891107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木上有水，津潤上行，井之象也。勞民者以君養民，勸相者使民相養，皆取井養之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205907491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木承水而上之，乃器汲水而出，井之象。君子觀井之象，法井之德，以勞徠其民，而勸勉以相助之道也。勞徠其民，法井之用也，勸民使相助法井之施也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205907491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：養而不窮，莫若勞民而勸，相也。○楊氏繪曰：水性潤下。能上潤於物者，井之用也。○朱子語類云：木上有水井，說者以爲木是汲器，則後面却有瓶，瓶自是瓦器，只是說水之津潤上行，至那木之杪，這便是井水上行之象。○又云：草木之生，津潤皆上行，直至樹末，便是木上有水之義如菖蒲葉，每晨葉尾皆有水如珠顆，雖藏之密室亦然，非露水也。問：如此，則井之義與木上有水何預？曰：木上有水，便如水本在井底，却能汲上來給人之食，故取象如此。〇李氏心傳曰：勸相卽相友、相助、相扶持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956067879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之意。案大象木上有水，須以朱子之說爲長。彖傳巽乎水而上水，則鄭氏桔槹之說不妨並存也。勞民者如巽風之布號令，勸相者，如坎水之相灌輸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井泥不食，下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205923875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊井无禽，時舍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205940259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205956643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言爲時所棄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205973027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以陰而居井之下，泥之象也。无水而泥，人所不食也，人不食，則水不上无。以及禽鳥，禽鳥亦不至矣。見其不能濟物，爲時所舍置不用也。若能及禽鳥，是亦有所濟也。舍，上聲。與乾之時。舍音，不同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205973027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：下也者，以其最在井下，故爲井泥也。時舍也者，人旣不食，禽亦不向，是一時。共棄舍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358651332034570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井谷射鮒，无與也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137205989411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206005795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"井以上出爲功。二陽剛之才，本可濟用，以在下而上无應援，是以下比而射鮒。若上有與之者，則當。汲引而上，成井之功矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206005795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"谷氏家杰曰：謂有泉而无與，與無泉而時棄者，自不可同也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井渫不食，行惻也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206022179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求王明，受福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206038563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206054947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"行惻者，行道之，人皆以爲惻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206071331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"井渫治而不見食，乃人有才知而不見用，以不得行爲憂。惻也。旣以不得行爲惻，則豈免有求也？故求王明而受福，志切於行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206071331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"趙氏汝楳曰：井，不以不食。爲憂賢者不以不遇而惻心惻者，行人也。行汲之人，爲之求王者之明也。求王之明，豈朋比以干禄，爲其見知。於上，則福被生民，猶井汲而出，然後利及於人也。〇王氏申子曰：井渫而不爲人所食，縱不自惻，行道之人，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358655937396763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爲之惻然矣。縱不求人之我用，人亦爲之求之，以並受其福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"井甃无咎，脩井也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206087715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206104099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甃者，脩治於井也，雖不能大其濟物之功，亦能脩治不廢也，故无咎，僅能免咎而已。若在剛陽，自不至如是如是則可咎矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206104099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虞氏翻曰：脩，治也。以瓦甓壘井稱甃，○蘇氏軾曰：脩，潔也。陽爲動，爲實陰。爲靜爲虚，泉者，所以爲井也，動也、實也。井者，泉之所寄也，靜也，虛也。初六最下，故曰泥，上六最上，故曰收。六四居其閒而不失正，故曰甃。甃之於井，所以禦惡而潔井也。井待是而潔，故无咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寒泉之食，中正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206120483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206136867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寒泉而可食，井道之至善者也。九五中正之德，爲至善之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380847631"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案詩云：泉之竭矣，不云自中。蓋不中則源不常裕而不寒也。又云：冽彼下泉，浸彼苞蕭。蓋不正則流不逮下而。不食也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"元吉，在上，大成也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206153251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206169635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以大善之吉，在卦之上，井道之大成也。井以上爲成功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤中有火。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206186019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"革，君子以治歷明時。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206202403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206218787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四時之變，革之大者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206235171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火相息爲革。革，變也。君子觀變革之象，推日月星辰之遷易以治。歷數，明四時之序也。夫變易之道，事之至大，理之至明，跡之至著，莫如四時。觀四時而順變革，則與天地合其序矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206235171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虞氏翻曰：暦象謂日月星辰也。天地革而四時成，故君子以治曆明時也。〇朱子語類云：治暦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121009718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明時，非謂曆當攺革，蓋四時變革中，便有箇治曆明時底道理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鞏用黃牛，不可以有爲也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206251555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206267939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以初九時位、才皆不可以。有爲，故當以中順自固也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206267939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏璦曰凡革之道必須巳日，然後。可以革之也，民固卽日而未孚，可遽革之乎？故但可固守中順，未可大有所爲。○鄭氏汝諧曰：居位之下，革之。而人未必從，當革之始，遽革而人未必信，固執中順之道，循理而變通可也，自我有爲，不可也。於革之初言之。欲其謹於始也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已日革之，行有嘉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206284323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206300707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳日而革之，征則吉而无咎者，行則有嘉慶也。謂可以革天下之獘，新天下之事，處而不行，是无救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611674906659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"獘濟世之心失，時而有咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206300707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：未當革而遽往，適以滋獘耳，何嘉之有？必往於巳日，當革。之時，則其行有嘉美之功。行釋征字，嘉，釋吉，无咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"革言三就，又何之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206317091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206333475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言己審。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206349859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"稽之衆論，至於三就，事至當也，又何之矣？乃俗語更何往也？如是而行，乃順理。時行非己之私意所欲爲也，必得其宜矣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206349859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徐氏幾曰：初未可革，二乃革之，三則變革之事成矣。凡事詳審至再、至三則止矣，又何往焉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"改命之吉，信志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206366243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206382627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"改命而吉，以上下信其志也。誠旣至，則上下信矣。革之道，以上下之信爲本。不當不孚，則不信，當而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358655937429531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不信猶不可行也，況不當乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206399011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：信志卽有孚之謂，革以有孚爲本，信足以孚乎人心則可。以改命而得吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大人虎變，其文炳也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206415395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206431779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事理明著，若虎文之炳煥明盛也，天下有不孚乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206431779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：虎之斑文，大而疎朗，革道已成，事理簡明，如虎文之炳然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子豹變，其文蔚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206448163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人革面，順以從君也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206464547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206480931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君子從化遷善，成文彬蔚，章見於外也。中人以上，莫不變革，雖不移之小人，則亦不敢肆其惡。革易其外以順從君上之敎令，是革面也。至此革道成矣。小人勉而假善，君子所容也，更往而治之，則凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206497315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074419238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206497315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：以柔爲德，不及九五，剛中炳明，故但文章蔚縟，能使小人攺觀而從也。〇呂氏大臨曰：上六與九五皆革道已成之時。虎之文脩大而有理，豹之文密茂而成斑，其文炳然，如火之照而易辨也，其文蔚然如草。之暢茂而叢聚也。〇俞氏琰曰：小人居革之終，幡然嚮道，以順從君，無不心悅而誠服。或者乃謂面革而心不革，非也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木上有火。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206513699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎，君子以正位凝命。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206530083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206546467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼎，重器也，故有正位凝命之意。凝猶至道不凝之凝，傳所謂協于上下，以承天休者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206562851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"木上有火，以木巽火也，烹餁之象，故爲鼎。君子觀鼎之象，以正位凝命。鼎者，法象之器，其形端正，其體安重，取其端正之象，則以正其位，謂正其所居之位。君子所處，必正其小，至於席不正不坐，毋跛毋倚，取其安重之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956166183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則凝其命令，安重其命令也。凝，聚止之義，謂安重也。今世俗有凝然之語，以命令而言耳。凡動爲皆當安重也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206562851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"房氏喬曰：鼎者神器，至大至重，正位凝命，法其重大，不可遷移也。○李氏元量曰：木上有火，非鼎也。鼎之用也，猶之木上有水，非井也，井之功也。〇鄭氏汝諧曰：革以改命，鼎以定命。知革而不知鼎，則天下之亂。滋矣。〇項氏安世曰：存神息氣，人所以凝壽命；中心無爲，以守至正，君所以凝天命。〇王氏申子曰：鼎形端而正體鎭而重，君子取其端正之象，以正其所居之位，使之愈久而愈安；取其鎭重之象，以凝其所受之命，使之。愈久而愈固。○胡氏炳文曰：鼎之器正，然後可凝其所受之實；君之位正，然後可凝其所受之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎顚趾，未悖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206579235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利出否，以從貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206595619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206612003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼎而顚趾，悖道也。而因可出否以從貴，則未爲悖也。從貴謂應四，亦爲取新之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206628387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼎覆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956149799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而趾顚，悖道也。然非必爲悖者，蓋有傾出否惡之時也。去故而納新，瀉惡而受美，從貴之義也。應於四上，從於貴者也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206628387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陸氏希聲曰：趾當承鼎，顚而覆之，悖也。於是，出其惡，故雖覆未悖，猶妾至賤不當貴，以其子，故得貴焉。春秋之義，母以子貴，是也。○鄭氏汝諧曰：初居下，乃鼎之趾，必顚趾者乃出否也，猶之妾也，其可。從上，以子也，子貴則母貴也。凡取新之義，必捨惡而取善，捨賤而取貴，期合於義。初之應乎四，顚趾也。從貴也。柔而應於上，必有此義乃可。案：傳於得妾之辭不釋，但以從貴之意包之，聖言之簡而盡如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎有實，愼所之也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206644771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"我仇有疾，終无尤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206661155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206677539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有實而不謹其所往，則爲仇所卽而陷於惡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206693923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鼎之有實，乃人之有。才業也，當愼所趨向。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358568956182567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不愼所往，則亦陷於非義。二能不暱於初，而上從六五之正應，乃是愼所之也。我仇有疾，舉上文也。我仇對己。者，謂初也。初比己而非正，是有疾也。旣自守以正，則彼不能卽我，所以終无過尤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206693923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：以陽居中故有實，實而與物競，則所喪多矣。故所之不可不愼也。案尤者，己之過尤也，人之怨尤也。能愼其所行，則雖我仇有疾害之心，无過尤之可指，而怨尤之念亦消矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎耳革，失其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206710307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206726691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"始與鼎耳革異者，失其相求之義也。與五非應，失求合之道也；不中，非同志之象也。是以其行塞而不通，然上明而下才，終必和合，故方雨而吉也。案象傳凡言義者，謂卦義也。此失其義，非謂己之所行失義，蓋謂爻象無相應之義爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358655937445915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆公餗，信如何也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206743075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206759459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言失信也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206775843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大臣當天下之任，必能成天下之治安，則不誤君上之所倚，下民之所望與己。致身任道之志，不失所期，乃所謂信也。不然，則失其職，誤上之委任，得爲信乎？故曰信如何也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206775843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏。𥳑曰：居大臣之位，是許國以大臣之事業也，而實則不稱折足覆餗，失許國之信矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎黃耳，中以爲實也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206792227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206808611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六五以得中爲善，是以中爲實德也。五之所以聰明應剛，爲鼎之主，得鼎之道，皆由得中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206808611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陸氏績曰：得中承陽，故曰中以爲實。○郭氏雍曰：中以爲實者，六五陰虛，以黃中之德爲實也，猶坤之六五，美在其中之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121042486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉鉉在上，剛柔節也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206824995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206841379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"剛而溫，乃有節也。上居成功致用之地，而剛柔中節，所以大吉无不利也。井、鼎皆以上出爲成功，而鼎不云元吉，何也？曰：井之功用皆在上出，又有博施有常之德，是以元吉。鼎以烹餁爲功，居上爲成德，與井異。以剛柔節故。得大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206841379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"熊氏良輔曰：上以剛居柔，故曰剛柔節而比德於玉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洊雷震，君子以恐懼脩省。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206857763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206874147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"洊，重襲也。上下皆震，故爲洊雷。雷重仍，則威益盛。君子觀洊雷威震之象，以恐懼自脩飭循省也。君子畏天之威，則脩正其身，思省其過咎，而攺之。不唯雷震，凡遇驚懼之事，皆當如是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206874147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：恐。懼脩省，所謂洊也。人能恐懼，則旣震矣，又脩省焉，洊在其中矣。〇胡氏炳文曰：恐懼作於心，脩省見於事，脩克。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121058870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"治之功，省審察之力。案恐懼脩省者，君子之洊雷也，非遇雷震而恐懼也，須從項氏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震來虩虩，恐致福也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206890531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"笑言啞啞，後有則也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206906915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206923299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"震來而能恐懼周顧，則无患矣，是能因恐懼而反致福也。因恐懼而自脩省，不敢違於法度，是由震。而後有法則，故能保其安吉，而笑言啞啞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206939683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"范氏仲淹曰：君子之懼於心也，思慮必愼，其始則百。志弗違於道，懼於身也。進退不履於危，則百行弗罹於禍，故初九震來而致福，愼於始也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震來厲，乗剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206956067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206972451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當震而乗剛，是以彼厲。而己危，震剛之來，其可禦乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206972451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：屯六二豫六五，噬嗑六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008272935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二、困六三、震六二皆言乗剛，惟困六三乗坎之中爻，其餘皆乗震之初也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震蘇蘇，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137206988835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207005219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其恐懼自失蘇蘇然，由其所處不當故也。不中不正，其能安乎？案震當虩虩，不當蘇蘇。六三當重震之閒，正奮厲以有爲之時也，而以陰不中正處之，至於蘇蘇緩散，故曰位。不當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震遂泥，未光也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207021603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207037987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽者，剛物，震者，動義。以剛處動，本有光亨之道，乃失其剛正，而陷於重陰，以致遂泥，豈能光也？云未。光見陽剛本能震也，以失德故泥耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121075254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案四有剛德，非失德者，此言未光，蓋志氣未能自遂，行拂亂其所爲耳，與噬嗑九四之未光同，皆謂所處者未。能遂其所志，非兌上未光之比。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震往來厲，危行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207054371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其事在中，大无喪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207070755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207087139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"往來皆厲，行則有危也。動皆有危，唯在无喪其事而己。其事，謂中也。能不失其中，則可自守也。大无喪以无喪爲大也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207087139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：无喪有事，猶云不失其所有也。以其乗剛故危，以其在中，故无喪禍至。與不至皆懼，則无喪有事。〇郭氏雍曰：二以來厲而喪貝，則五之往來皆厲，宜其大有喪也。六五位雖不正，而用中焉。其事旣不失中道，雖涉危行，可以大无喪矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震索索，中未得也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207103523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖凶无咎，畏鄰戒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207119907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008289319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207136291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中，謂中心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207152675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以恐懼自失如此，以未得於中道也，謂過中也。使之得中，則不至於索索矣。極而復征，則凶也。若能見鄰戒而知懼，變於未極之前，則无咎也。上六，動之極，震極則有變義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207169059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吳氏澄曰：畏鄰戒，謂因鄰之戒而知畏也。○龔氏煥曰：中未得者，處震之極，志氣消索，中無所主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兼山艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207185443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以思不出其位。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207201827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207218211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上下皆山，故爲兼山。此而幷彼爲兼，謂重復也。重艮之象也。君子觀艮止之象，而思安所止，不出其位也。位者，所處之分也。萬事各有其所，得其所則止而安。若當行而止，當速而久，或過或不及，皆出其位也。況踰分非據乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207234595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"董氏曰：兩雷、兩風、兩火、兩水、兩澤，皆有相往來之理，惟兩山並立，不相往來，此止之。象也。○丘氏富國曰：凡人所爲，所以易至於出位者，以其不能思也。思則心有所悟，知其所當止，而得所止矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074484774"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案思不出位，諸家皆作思欲不出其位，思字不甚重，今觀咸卦云：貞吉悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思，而夫子以何？思何慮？明之，則此思字蓋不可畧。雜擾之思，動於欲者也；通微之思，濬於理者也。大學云：安而后能慮，蓋思不出位之說也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮其趾，未失正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207250979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207267363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當止而行，非正也。止之於初，故未至失正事止於始，則易而未至於失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207267363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虞氏翻曰：動而得正，故未失正也。○郭氏雍曰：趾，初象也。動莫先於趾，止於動之先則易，而止於旣動之後則難。傳言未失正。者，止於動之先，未有失正之事也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拯其隨，未退聽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207283747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380929551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207300131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三止乎上，亦不，肯退而聽乎？二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207300131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以不拯之而唯隨者，在上者未能下從也。退聽下從也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮其限，危薰心也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207316515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207332899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂其固止，不能進退危懼。鄭氏汝諧曰：三雖集之，慮常薰爍，說其中心也。止而不與物交，而其危則實薰心也。〇何氏楷曰：以強制故危。薫心。艮限者，強制之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮其身，止諸躬也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207349283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207365667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不能爲天下之止，能止於其身而己，豈足稱大臣之位也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207382051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：止諸躬也者，躬猶身也，明能靜止其身，不爲躁動也。〇王氏應麟曰：艮六四艮其身象，以躬解之，傴背爲躬，見背而不見面。朱文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074517542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"公詩云：反躬艮其背。案：止諸躬，便是艮其身，但易其字爲諸字爾。蓋易其字爲諸字，便見得是止之於躬，與夫正本清源，自然而止。者畧異矣。王氏解，姑備一說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮其輔，以中正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207398435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207414819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正字羡文。叶韻，可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207414819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五之所善者中也。艮其輔，謂止。於中也。言以得中爲正，止之於輔使不失中，乃得正也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207414819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"余氏本曰：言不妄發，發必當理，唯有中德者能之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"敦艮之吉，以厚終也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207431203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207447587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天下之事，唯終守之爲難，能敦於止，有終者也。上之吉，以其能厚於終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207447587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380978703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"愈厚而止愈安，是止之善終者也，其吉可知。案艮者，萬物之所成終而所成始，故於上言厚終。凡人之心，惟患其養之不厚，不患其發之不光，水蓄則彌盛。火宿則彌壯厚，其終則萬事皆由此始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上有木。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137207463971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漸，君子以居賢德善俗。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805627426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805643810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二者皆當以漸而進，疑賢字衍，或善下有脫字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805643810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山上有木，其高有因，漸之義也，君子觀漸。之象，以居賢善之德，化美於風俗。人之進於賢德，必有其漸習而後能安，非可陵節而遽至也。在己且然，敎化之於人不以漸，其能入乎？移風易俗，非一朝一夕所能成，故善俗必以漸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805643810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏曰：地中生木，以時而升。山上有木，其進以漸。○馮氏當可曰：居，積也。德以漸而積，俗以漸而善。内卦艮止，居德者止，諸內也。外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380962319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦：巽入善俗者，入於外也。體艮以居德，體巽以善俗。案地中生木，始生之木也；山上有木，高大之木也。凡木始生，枝條驟長，旦異而夕不同，及旣高大，則自拱把而合抱，自捩手而干霄，必須踰年積嵗，此升與漸之義所以異也。居德善俗，皆須以漸，又居賢德，然後可以善俗。亦漸之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小子之厲，義无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805660194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805676578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖小子以爲危厲，在義理實无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飮食衎衎，不素飽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805692962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805709346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"素飽如詩言素餐，得之以道，則不爲徒飽而處之安矣。程傳爻辭以其進之安平，故取飲食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074533926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"和樂爲言，夫子恐後人之未喻，又釋之云：中正君子遇中正之主，漸進於上，将行其道，以及天下，所謂飮食衎衎，謂其得志和樂，不謂空飽飲食而己素空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805725730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：二以中正應五而得祿，非尸位素餐者比。故食之衎衎而樂也。案六爻以鴻取進象，自水涯以至山上，自遠而近，自下而高也。干爲最遠，是士之將進而不苟進者，故在詩曰：置之河之干兮，彼君子兮，不素餐兮。二雖近爲時用，漸于磐矣，而不忘不素餐之義，所謂達不變塞者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫征不復，離羣醜也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805742114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"婦孕不育，失其道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805758498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利用禦寇，順相保也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805774882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
