{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805791266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫征不復，則失漸之正，從欲而失正，離判其羣類，爲可醜也。卦之諸爻，皆无不善，若獨失正，是離其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585380995087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羣類婦孕，不由其道，所以不育也。所利在禦宼，謂以順道相保，君子之與小人比也。自守以正，豈唯君子自守。其已而已乎，亦使小人得不陷於非義。是以順道相保，禦止其惡，故曰禦寇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805791266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏簡曰：夫征不復。上九不應，離羣醜也。婦孕不育，九三，失其所以爲婦也。三不中，有失道之象，故凶。非正者足以害我，故曰宼慮。三之失道，或親於宼而不能禦也，故敎之禦寇，則我不失於正順，而夫婦可以相保矣。〇熊氏良輔曰：順相保。順、愼通用，只是謹愼以相保守也。案楊氏之說，爻義文意兩得之矣。君子之仕也，上雖不交，而己必盡其道。故周公曰：恩斯勤斯，育，子之閔斯，不可以不遇而遂棄其殷勤也。王仲淹曰：美哉公旦之爲周也，必使我君臣相安而禍亂不作，其順相保之謂乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或得其桷，順以巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805807650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358578074583078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805824034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"桷者，平安之處。求安之道，唯順與巽。若其義順正，其處卑巽，何處而不安？如四之順正而巽，乃得桷。也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終莫之勝吉，得所願也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805840418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805856802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"君臣以中正相交，其道當行，雖有間其閒者，終豈能勝哉？徐必得其所願，乃漸之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其羽可用爲儀，吉，不可亂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805873186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805889570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"漸進愈高，而不爲无用，其志卓然，豈可得而亂哉！程傳君子之進，自下而上，由微而著，跬步造次莫不有序，不失其序，則无所不得其吉。故九雖窮高而不失其吉，可用爲儀法者，以其有序而不可亂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805889570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：二居有用之位，有益於人之國家而非素飽者；上在無用之地，亦足爲人之儀表而非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585381027855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無用者二，志不在溫飽上，志卓然不可亂。士大夫之出處，於此當有取焉。○張氏振淵曰：志慮高潔而功名富。貴不足以累其心，故其志可則，使志可得而亂，又安可用爲儀哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤上有雷。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805905954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸妹，君子以永終知敝。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805922338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805938722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷動澤隨，歸妹之象，君子觀其合之不正。知其終之有敝也。推之事物，莫不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805938722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷震於上，澤隨而動，陽動於上，陰說而從，女從男之象也，故爲歸妹。君子觀男女配合，生息相續之象而以永其終。知有敝也。永終，謂生息嗣續，永久其傳也。知敝，謂知物有敝壞，而爲相繼之道也。女歸則有生息，故有永終之。義。又夫婦之道，當常永有終，必知其有敝壞之理而戒愼之。敝壞，謂離隙。歸妹，說以動者也，異乎恆之巽而動。漸之止而巽也。少女之說，情之感動，動則失正，非夫婦正而可常之道，久必敝壞。知其必敝，則當思永其終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611674988579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天下之反目者，皆不能永終者也。不獨夫婦之道，天下之事，莫不有終有敝，莫不有可繼可久之道。觀歸妹，則當思永終之戒也。集說崔氏憬曰：歸妹，人之始終也。始則征凶，終則无攸利，故君子以永終知敝爲戒。者也。○吳氏曰：愼曰：永終知敝，言遠慮其終而知有敝也。氓之詩，不思其反，所以終見棄於人與。案澤上有雷，不當以澤從雷取象，當以澤感雷取象，蓋取於陰氣先動爲歸妹之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸妹以娣，以恆也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805955106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"跛能履，吉，相承也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805971490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805987874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"恆，謂有常久之德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805987874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"歸妹之義，以說而動，非夫婦能常之道。九乃剛陽，有賢貞之德，雖娣之微，乃能以常者也。雖在下不能有所爲，如跛者之能履然，征而吉者，以其能相承助也。能助其君，娣之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137805987874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄭氏汝諧曰：初少女且微而在下，以娣媵而歸，乃其常也。娣媵不能成內助之功，雖有其德，如跛者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675004963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之履耳。跛者之履，雖不足以有行，然亦可以行者，以其佐小君能相承助也。如是而征，則爲安分，故吉。○俞氏琰曰：相承者，佐其嫡以相與奉承其夫也。案言以恆者，女而自歸非常，惟娣則從嫡而歸，乃其常也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利幽人之貞，未變常也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806004258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806020642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"守其幽貞，未失夫婦常正之道也。世人以媟狎爲常，故以貞靜爲變常，不知乃常久之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806020642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：屯六二曰反常，謂字乃女子之常，不字則非常，至十年之後而乃字，則返其常也。此曰未變常。謂嫁者，女子之常。九二不願嫁，似乎變常，然能以幽靜自守，是亦女德之常，未爲變常也。〇來氏知德曰：一與。之齊，終身不改，此婦道之常也。守幽人之貞，則未變其常矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675021347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歸妹以須，未當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806020642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806037026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"未當者，其處其德，其求歸之道皆不當，故无取之者，所以須也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806037026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱氏震曰：六三，居不當位。德不正也。柔而上剛，行不順也。爲說之主，以說而歸，動非禮也。上無應，無受之者也。如是而賤矣，故曰未當也。未當，故無取之者，反歸以娣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愆期之志，有待而行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806053410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806069794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以愆期者，由己而不由彼。賢女人所願取，所以愆期，乃其志欲有所待，待得佳配而後行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806069794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：嫁宜及時，今乃過期而遲歸者，此嫁者之志，欲有所待而後乃行也。○俞氏琰曰：爻辭言愆。期，而爻傳直述其志，以見愆期在我，而不苟從人，蓋有待而行，非爲人所棄也。行謂出嫁。詩泉水云：女子有行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048443955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝乙歸妹，不如其娣之袂良也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806086178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其位在中，以貴行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806102562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806118946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以其有中德之貴，而行，故不尚飾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806135330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以帝乙歸妹之道言，其袂不如其娣之袂良，尚禮而不尚飾也。五以柔中，在尊高之位，以尊貴而行。中道也。柔順降屈，尚禮而不尚飾，乃中道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806135330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏。申子曰：上二句舉爻辭，下二句釋之也。言五居尊位而用中，故能以至貴而行其勤儉謙遜之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上六。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806151714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无實，承虛筐也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806168098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806184482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"筐无實，是空筐也。空筐可以祭乎？言不可以奉祭祀也。女不可以承祭祀，則離絶而已，是女歸之无。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048460339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"終者，也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806184482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏宗傳曰：專取虚筐无實爲言者，上六女子也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷電皆至。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806200866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐，君子以折獄致刑。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806217250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806233634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"取其威照。程雷電皆至，明震並行也。二體相合，傳並行之象，故云皆至。明動相資，成豐之象離明也，照察之象。震，動也，威斷之象。折獄者必照其情實，唯明克允；致刑者以威於姦惡，唯斷乃成。故君子觀雷。電，明動之象，以折獄致刑也。噬嗑言先王飭法，豐言君子折獄，以明在上而麗於威震，王者之事，故爲制刑立法以明在下而麗於威震，君子之用，故爲折獄致刑。旅明在上，而云君子者，旅取愼用刑與不留獄君子皆當然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806233634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：斷決獄訟，須得虚實之情，致用刑。罰必得輕重之中，若動而不明，則淫濫斯及。故君子象於此卦而折獄致刑。○蘇氏軾曰：傳曰：爲刑罰威獄，以類天之震曜。故易至於雷電相遇，則必及刑獄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121124406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"取其明以動也。至於離，與艮相遇，曰无折獄，无留獄，取其明以止也。○朱氏震曰：電，明照也，所以折獄，雷威怒。也，所以致刑。〇朱子語類問：雷電噬嗑，與雷電豐亦同。曰：噬嗑明在上，是明得事理，先立這法在此，未有犯威人。留待異時之用，故云明罰飭法，豐威在上，明在下。是用這法時，須是明見下情曲折方得。不然威動於上，必有過錯也，故云折獄致刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖旬无咎，過旬災也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806250018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806266402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戒占者不可求勝。其配，亦爻辭外意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806266402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"聖人因時而處宜，隨事而順理，夫勢均則不相下者。常理也，然有雖敵而相資者，則相求也。初、四是也，所以雖旬而无咎也。與人同而力均者，在乎降己以相求協。力以從事，若懷先己之私，有加上之意，則患當至矣。故曰過旬災也。均而先已，是過旬也。一求勝，則不能同矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048493107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806266402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"劉氏牧曰：旬，數之極也，猶日之中也。言无咎者，謂初未至中，猶可進也。若進而過中則災，故象稱過。旬，災也。爻辭不言豐者，謂初未至豐也。○胡氏瑗曰：言雖居豐盈之時，可以无咎，若過於盈滿，則必有傾覆之災也。〇俞氏琰曰：爻辭云雖旬无咎，爻傳云過旬災，則戒其不可過也。蓋與彖傳天地日月說同。案：過旬災，卽日中則昃，月盈則食之意也。經意謂同德相濟，雖當盈滿之時，可以无咎。況初居豐之始，未及日中乎？傳意則謂正宜及今而圖之耳，稍過於中，便将有災矣。其義相備也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有孚發若，信以發志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806282786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806299170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有孚發若，謂以己之孚信感發上之心志也。苟能發，則其吉可知，雖柔暗，有可發之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806299170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。趙氏汝楳曰：疾，得於境之疑，孚發於志之信。○王氏申子曰：二虛中，故有孚，五亦虛中，故可發言，以誠相感也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358585381044239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐其沛，不可大事也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806315554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"折其右肱，終不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806331938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806348322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三應於上，上應而无位，陰柔无勢力，而處旣終，其可共濟大事乎？旣无所賴，如右肱之折，終不可用。矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806348322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"潘氏士藻曰：六二雖當豐蔀之時，然五得位得中，猶可以大事，故六二發若之孚，可施也。九三所應上六，无可發之明矣。不可用而不用，保身之哲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐其蔀，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806364706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日中見斗，幽不明也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806381090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇其夷主，吉行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806397474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806413858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"位不當，謂以不中正居高位，所以闇而不能致豐。日中見斗，幽不明也。謂幽暗不能光明。君陰柔而臣不中正故也。遇其夷主，吉，行也。陽剛相遇，吉之行也。下就於初，故云行。下求則爲吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806413858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏。安世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048509491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：六二指六五爲蔀爲斗，故往則入於闇而得疑。九四之蔀與斗皆自指也，故行則遇明而得吉。○吳氏澄曰：豐蔀見斗六二爻辭己備，象傳不釋，而獨九四致其詳者，蓋二象由九四而成，四爲蔀，故二見斗。二爻之象同。而所重在四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六五之吉，有慶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806430242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806446626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其所謂吉者，可以有慶福及於天下也。人君雖柔暗，若能用賢才，則可以爲天下之福，唯患不能耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806446626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何氏楷曰：人君以天下常豐爲慶，慶以天下故吉。言慶則譽在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豐其屋，天際翔也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806463010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"闚其戸，闃其无人，自藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806479394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806495778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"藏，謂障蔽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806495778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六，處豐大之極，在上而自高，若飛翔於天際，謂其高大之甚，闚其户而无人者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675037731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖居豐大之極，而實无位之地。人以其昏暗自高大，故皆棄絶之，自藏避而弗與親也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806495778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"石氏介曰：始顯大，終自藏，皆聖人戒其過盛。子雲曰：炎炎者滅，隆隆者絶。觀雷觀火，爲盈爲實。天收其聲，地藏其熱，高明之家，鬼瞰其室，正合此義。○張子曰：豐屋蔀家，自蔽之甚，窮大而失居者也。處上之極，不交於下，而居動之末。故曰天際翔也。○朱子語類云：豐其屋，天際翔也。似說如翬斯飛樣。言其屋高大，到於天際，却只是自蔽障得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濶。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806512162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上有火。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806528546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旅，君子以明愼用刑而不留獄。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806544930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806561314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"愼刑如山，不留如火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806561314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：火之在高，明无不照。君子觀明照之象，則以明愼用刑，明不可恃，故戒於愼明，而止亦愼象。觀火行不處之象，則不留獄。獄者不得已而設，民有罪而入，豈可留滯淹久也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806561314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358593121189942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806561314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：火在山上，逐草而行，勢不久留，故爲旅象。又上下二體，艮止離明，故君子象此以明察審愼。用刑而不稽留獄訟。○項氏安世曰：山非火之所留也，野燒延緣，過之而已，故名之曰旅，而象之以不留獄。○趙氏汝楳曰：火煬則宅於竈，冶則宅於爐，在山則野燒之暫，猶旅寓耳，故爲旅之象。離虛爲明，艮止，爲謹，君子。體之明，謹於用刑而不留獄。蓋獄者，人之所旅也。不留獄，不使久處其中也。用刑固貴於明，然明者未必謹謹。者或留獄，明矣，謹矣，而淹延不決，雖明猶闇也，雖謹反害也。○張氏淸子曰：明則無遁情，愼則無濫罰。明、愼旣盡，斷決隨之。聖人取象於旅，正恐其留獄也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旅瑣瑣，志窮災也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806577698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806594082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"志意窮迫，益自取災也。災眚對言則有分，獨言則謂災患耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806594082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"谷氏家杰曰：爻賤其行象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358655937495067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鄙其志。〇楊氏啓新曰：窮，不是困窮局促猥陋之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得童僕貞，終无尤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806610466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806626850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羈旅之人，所賴者童僕也。旣得童僕之忠貞，終无尤悔矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806626850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏弼曰：旣得童僕，然後卽次。懷資皆无所失，故終无尤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旅焚其次，亦以傷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806643234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以旅與下，其義喪也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806659618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806676002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以旅之時而與下之。道如此，義當喪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806676002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旅焚，失其次舍，亦以困傷矣。以旅之時而與下之道如此，義當喪也。在旅而以過剛自高待下，必喪其忠貞，謂失其心也。在旅而失其童僕之心，爲可危也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806676002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭氏雍曰：九三剛而不中，故不能安旅，失其所安，亦可傷矣。以剛暴之才，而以旅道居童僕，宜其失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008387623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衆心而喪也。夫旅豈與人之道哉？君子自厚而已，故終無以旅與下之事。○王氏宗傳曰：旣己有焚，其次之傷。矣，而又喪其童僕焉，此暴厲之過也。夫旅，親寡之時也，朝夕之所與者童僕而己爾，豈可以旅視之也？九三，以旅視乎下，則彼童僕也，亦必以旅視乎上矣，其能久留乎？故曰其義喪也。○黃氏淳耀曰：下卽童僕以旅與下。者，謂視童僕如旅人也。焚次而失其身所依庇，亦已傷而不安矣，況又喪其童僕乎？然非童僕之無良也，當旅。時，而與下之道，刻薄寡恩，直若旅人然，宜不得其心力，義當喪也，将誰咎哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旅于處，未得位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806692386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得其資斧，心未快也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806708770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806725154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四以近君爲當位，在旅五不取君義，故四爲未得位也。曰：然則以九居四，不正爲有咎矣。曰：以剛居柔，旅之宜也。九以剛明之才，欲得時而行其志，故雖得資斧，於旅爲善，其心志未快也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806725154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黃氏淳耀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008371239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：資斧，防患之物。得其資斧，不過有以自防，故曰心未快也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終以譽命，上逮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806741538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806757922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上逮，言其譽命聞於上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806757922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有文明柔順之德，則上下與之。逮，與也。能順承於上而上與之。爲上所逮也。在上而得乎下，爲下所上逮也。在旅而上下與之，所以致譽命也。旅者，困而未得所安之時也。終以譽命，終，當致譽命也。已譽命，則非旅也，困而親寡，則爲旅，不必在外也。集說胡氏瑗曰：六五所謂柔得中乎外而順乎剛者也。柔順中正之德，爲上九所信，尊顯之命及之也。案六五有位，而上九無位，不必以六五爲上九所尊顯也。蓋居高位便是上逮爾。此爻雖不以君位言，而亦主於大夫士之載贄而獲乎名位者，故曰上逮，言其地望已高也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008404007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以旅在上，其義焚也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806774306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喪牛于易，終莫之聞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806790690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806807074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以旅在上，而以尊高自處，豈能保其居？其義當有焚巢之事。方以極剛自高爲得志而笑，不知喪其順德於躁易，是終莫之聞，謂終不自聞知也。使自覺知，則不至於極而號咷矣。陽剛不中而處極，固有高亢躁動之象，而火復炎上，則又甚焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806807074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張子曰：以陽極上，旅而驕肆者也，失柔順之正，故曰喪牛于易，怒而忤物，雖有凶危，其誰告之？故曰終莫之聞也。案：九三以旅與下，郭氏、王氏、黃氏之說美矣，惟以旅在上則未有說。蓋以旅之道在上，則視所居之位如寄寓。然其無敬愼之心可知，故曰其義焚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨風巽，君子以申命行事。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806823458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713779731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806839842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"隨，相繼。之義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806839842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：兩風相重，隨風也。隨，相繼之義。君子觀重巽相繼以順之象，而以申命令。行政事，隨與重，上下皆順也。上順下而出之，下順上而從之，上下皆順，重巽之義也。命令政事順理則合民心。而民順從矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806839842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"荀氏爽曰：巽爲號令，兩巽相隨，故申命也。法敎百端，令行爲上，故曰行事也。○胡氏瑗曰：巽之體，上下皆巽，如風之入物，無所不至，無所不順，故曰隨風巽。君子法此巽風之象，以申其命，行其事。於天下，無有不至，而無有不順者也。〇郭氏雍曰：君子之德，風也。有風之德而下無不從，然後具重巽之義。易於巽主敎命，猶詩之言風也。故觀則省方觀民設敎，姤則施命誥四方，皆主巽而言也。〇丘氏富國曰：申命者，所以致其戒於行事之先，行事者所以踐其言於申命之後。〇俞氏琰曰：旣告戒之，又丁寧之，使人聽信其說。然後見之行事，則民之從之也，亦如風之迅速也。大抵命令之出，務在必行，不行則徒爲虛文耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687470288922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進退，志疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806856226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"利武人之貞，志治也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806872610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806888994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"進退不知所安者，其志疑懼也。利用武人之剛貞，以立其志，則其志治也。治，謂脩立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806888994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"趙氏汝楳曰：治與疑對，志疑而不決，故進退靡定；志治而不亂，故決於行。○黃氏淳耀曰：兩可不決之謂疑。一。定不亂之謂治。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紛若之吉，得中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806905378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806921762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二以居柔在下，爲過巽之象，而能使通其誠意者，衆多紛然，由得中也。陽居中，爲中實之象，中旣誠。實則人自當信之以誠。意則非諂畏也，所以吉而无咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806921762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭氏雍曰：二有剛中之德，能行巽之道，是其所以无咎也。○何氏楷曰：申命行事，紛若而得中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713812499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頻巽之吝，志窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806938146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806954530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三之才質，本非能巽，而上臨之以巽承重剛而履剛，勢不得行其志，故頻失而頻巽，是其志窮困可。吝之甚，也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806954530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏濬曰：九三之頻巽，非勉爲之而失，習爲之而過也。巽而频焉，則振作之氣不足其志。亦窮而無所復之矣。〇張氏振淵曰：志疑者可以治救之，志窮則有吝而己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田獲三品，有功也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806970914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806987298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽於上下，如田之獲三品。而遍及上下，成巽之功也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137806987298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：有功，者，田獵有獲以喻。行命，有功也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九五之吉，位正中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807003682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713796115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807020066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九五之吉，以處正中也。得正中之道，則吉，而其悔亡也。正中，謂不過无不及，正得其中也。處柔巽與。出命令，唯得中爲善，失中則悔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807020066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丘氏富國曰：以九居五，位乎中正，此所以貞吉而爲申命之主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽在牀下，上窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807036450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喪其資斧，正乎凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807052834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807069218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正乎凶言必凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807069218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽在牀下，過於巽也。處卦之上，巽至於窮極也。居上而過極於巽，至於自失得爲正乎？乃凶道也。巽本善行，故疑之曰：得爲正乎？復斷之曰：乃凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807085602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏啓新曰：巽在牀下，居巽之極也。天下事惟斷乃成，今焉喪其資斧，是失所以斷矣。無斷則敗，可必其凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"麗澤兌，君子以朋友講習。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807101986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008420391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807118370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"兩澤相麗，互相滋益，朋友講習，其象如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807118370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"麗澤，二澤相附麗也。兩澤相麗，交相浸潤，互有滋益之象，故君子觀其象而以朋友講習。朋友講習，互相益也。先儒謂天下之可說，莫若朋友講習。朋友講習。固可說之大者。然當明相益之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807118370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虞氏翻曰：學以聚之，問以辨之，兌兩口對，故朋友講習也。〇孔氏穎達曰：同門曰朋，同志曰友，朋友聚居，講習道義，相說之盛，莫過於此也。〇程子曰：天下之說不可極，惟朋。友講習，雖過說無害，兌澤有相滋益處。○蘇氏軾曰：取其樂而不流者也。○朱氏震曰：講其所知，習其所行。○蔡氏淵曰：講，兌象，習，重兌象。〇俞氏琰曰：講者，講其所未明，講多則義理明矣。習者，習其所未熟，習久則踐履。熟矣。此朋友講習，所以爲有滋益，而如兩澤之相麗也。若獨學無友，則孤陋而寡聞，故論語以學之不講爲憂。以學而時習爲說，以有朋自遠方來爲樂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713828883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"和兌之吉，行未疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807134754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807151138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居卦之初，其說也正，未有所疑也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807167522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有求而和，則涉於邪諂。初隨時順處，心无所係，无所爲也，以和而已，是以吉也。象又以其處說在下而非中正，故云行未疑也。其行未有可疑，謂未見其有失也。若得中正則无是言也。說以中正爲本爻，直陳其義，象則推而盡之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807167522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"。蔡氏淵曰：初未牽於陰，所行未有疑惑，若四比三，有商兌之疑矣。○徐氏幾曰：疑，謂係於陰也。卦四陽，惟初與陰無係，故未疑。○鄭氏維嶽曰：以陽剛居兌初，又不與陰比，故信心信理而出行之於外者，未與心疑，使有繫應，便不能自決矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孚兌之吉，信志也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807183906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807200290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"心之所存爲志，二剛實居中，孚信存於中也。志存誠信，豈至說小人而自失乎？是以吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807200290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048558643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何氏楷曰：初去三遠，不特志可信，而行亦未涉於可疑；二去三近，行雖不免於可疑，而志則可信。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"來兌之凶，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807216674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807233058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自處不中正，无與，而妄求說，所以凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807233058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"熊氏良輔曰：六三位不當，居上下二兌之閒，下兌方終，上兌又來，說而又說，不得其正者也。上六曰引兌，蓋與六三相表裏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九四之喜，有慶也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312137807249442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619322383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂喜者，若守正而君說之則得。行其陽剛之道，而福慶及物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619322383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"郭氏雍曰：當兌之時，處上下之際，不妄從說，知所擇者也。介然自守，故能全兌說之喜，喜非獨一身而己，終亦有及物之慶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孚于剝，位正當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619338767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675070499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619355151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與履九五同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619355151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戒孚于剝者，以五所處之位，正當戒也。密比陰柔，有相說之道，故戒在信。之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619355151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：謂正當尊位，若孚上之柔說，則消剝於陽必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上六引兌，未光也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619371535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619387919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"說旣極矣，又引而長之，雖說之之心不已，而事理已過，實无所說。事之盛則有光輝，旣極而強引之。長，其无意味甚矣。豈有光也？未非必之辭，象中多用非必能有光輝，謂不能光也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619387919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏啓新曰來。兌引兌，皆小人也，在君子則當來而勿受，引而勿去也。君子以道德相引，其道爲光明；引而爲說，則心術曖昧。行事邪僻甚矣，豈得爲光乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風行水上，渙。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619404303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先王以享于帝立廟。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619420687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687470338074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619437071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皆所以合其散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619437071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風行水上，有渙散之象。先王觀是象，救天下之渙散，至於享帝立廟也。收合人心，无如宗廟，祭祀之報，出於其心，故享帝立。廟，人心之所歸也。係人心，合離散之道，无大於此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619437071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：程子曰：萃、渙皆享于帝，立廟，因其精神之聚而形於此，爲其渙散，故立此以收之。〇呂氏大臨曰：風行水上波。瀾必作振蕩離散不寧之時。王者求以合其散，莫若反其本，享帝立廟，所以明天人之本也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初六之吉，順也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619453455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619469839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"初之所以吉者，以其能順從剛中。之才也。始渙，用能順乎時也。集說郭氏雍曰：而拯初六，難之。始也。方難之始而拯之，無不濟矣。天下之事，辦之於早，則順而易舉。故傳曰：初六之吉，順也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渙奔其机，得願也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619486223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460398627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619502607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"渙散之時，以合爲安，二居險中，急就於初，求安也。賴之如机而亡其悔，乃得所願也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619502607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏宗傳曰：當渙之時，以陽剛來居二，二，安靜之位也，故有奔其机之象。夫惟安靜，然後能一天下之動，五奠王居。於上，而二奔其机於下，各得所安，此所以能合天下之渙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渙其躬，志在外也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619518991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619535375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"志應於上，在外也。與上相應，故其身得免於渙而无悔。悔亡者，本有而得亡；无悔者，本无也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619535375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黃氏淳耀曰：外指天下言。惟躬之渙，所以能濟天下之渙；惟志在天下之渙，所以有躬之渙也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渙其羣，元吉，光大也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619551759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619568143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"稱元吉者，謂其功德光大也。元吉光大不在五而在四者，二爻之義通言也。於四言其施用，於五言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460382243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其成功，君臣之分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619568143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"來氏知德曰：凡樹私黨者，皆心之暗昧狹小者也。惟無一豪之私，則光明正大。自能渙其羣矣，故曰光大也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"王居无咎，正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619584527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619600911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王居謂正位，人君之尊位也。能如五之爲，則居尊位爲稱而无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619600911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"熊氏良輔曰：天下渙。散之時，須人君發號施令，正位乎上，使人心知所歸向，而天下一矣，故曰王居无咎，而象曰正位也。此與萃有位之義同。本義以渙王居爲渙其居積，然當渙散之時，必有爲渙之主者，所當從小象正位之說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渙其血，遠害也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619617295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619633679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若如象文爲渙其血，乃與屯其膏同也，義則不然，蓋血字下脫去字，血去惕出，謂能遠害則无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687470354458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619633679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"項氏安世曰：上九爻辭血與出韻叶，皆三字成句，不以血連去字也。小畜之血去惕出，與此不同。此血已散，不假更去。又惕與逖文義自殊。據小象言遠害也，則逖義甚明，不容作惕矣。卦中惟上九一爻，去險最遠，故其辭如此。○又曰：散其汗以去滯鬱，散其血以遠傷害。○陳氏友文曰：坎爲血卦，逖，遠也。小象遠害正是。以遠釋逖字。上雖與三應，然超處渙上，故渙散其血，捨之遠去，去坎險之害，而得无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤上有水。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619650063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節，君子以制數度，議德行。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619666447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619682831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤之容水有限，過則盈溢，是有節，故爲節也。君子觀節之象，以制立數度，凡物之大小輕重、高下文質皆有數度，所以爲節也。數多寡，度法制。議德行者，存諸中爲德，發於外爲行。人之德行，當議則中節。議謂商。度，求中節也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619682831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"侯氏行果曰：澤上有水，以隄防爲節。○張氏浚曰：數度之制因乎人，德行之議自於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048591411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"己。記曰：君子議道自己，而置法以民。蓋己之所不能行，與其所不可行而強於人，誰其從之？一言盡節之道中而已。中必自身始也。〇朱氏震曰：澤之容水，固有限量，虛則納之，滿則泄之，水以澤爲節也。○郭氏雍曰：澤无水則爲不足，澤上有水，則爲有餘，不足則爲困，有餘則當節，理之常也。在人之節，則制數度，所以節於外議德。行，所以節於内也。爲國爲家，至於一身，其内外制節皆一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"附錄","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619699215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：數度，謂尊卑禮命之多。少德行，謂人才堪任之優劣。君子象節以制其禮數等差，皆使有度。議人之德行任用，皆使得宜。案：議德行，諸儒皆謂一身之德行，獨孔氏謂在人之德行，於議字尤切，且得愛爵祿、愼名器之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不出戶庭，知通塞也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619715599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619731983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻辭於節之初，戒之謹守，故云不出戸庭，則无咎也。象恐人之泥於言也，故復明之云：雖當謹守，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460447779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"出戸庭，又必知時之通塞也。通則行，塞則止，義當出則出矣。尾生之信水至不去，不知通塞也，故君子貞而不諒繫辭所解，獨以言者在人，所節唯言與行，節於言，則行可知，言當在先也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619731983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：時有通。塞，通則行，塞則止，當止卽止，其知通塞之君子乎！繫辭專以愼密言語說之，兌體故也。〇吳氏曰：愼曰節，兼通。塞言，猶艮之兼行止言也。初九不出戸庭，知塞也。而兼言知通者，見其非一於止者也。二失時極，則但知塞，而不知通矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不出門庭，凶，失時極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619748367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619764751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不能上從九五剛中正之道，成節之功，乃係於私暱之陰柔，是失時之至極，所以凶也。失時，失其所宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619764751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蘇氏軾曰：水之始至，澤當塞而不當通；旣至，當通而不當塞，故初九以不出戸庭爲无咎，言當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675136035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"塞也。九二以不出門庭爲凶，言當通也。至是而不通，則失時而至於極。〇郭氏雍曰：初爲不當有事之地，而二以剛中居有爲之位，其道不可同也。故初以不出戸庭爲知塞，而二以不出門庭爲不知通，知塞，故无咎不知。通則有失時之凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不節之嗟，又誰咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619781135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619797519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此无咎與諸爻異，言无所歸咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619797519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"節則可以免過，而不能自節，以致可嗟，将誰咎乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619797519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"沈氏一貫曰：王介甫、程沙隨謂能嗟怨自治，亦无咎。嗟與戚嗟若之嗟同，又誰咎，與出門同人之象。同〇何氏楷曰：諸卦爻辭言无咎者九十有九，多補過之辭。解三爻傳又誰咎語雖與此同，然爻辭未嘗有无。咎字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675152419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安節之亨，承上道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619813903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619830287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四能安節之義非一，象，獨舉其重者，上承九五剛中正之道以爲節，足以亨矣。餘善亦不出於中正。也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619830287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"錢氏一本曰：中正之通在五，四以近承，不以徒止爲功，更以通行爲道，故曰承上道也。案節曰亨，爲九五中正以通也，而亨於四言之者，五者，水之源也，四者，水之流也。水之通在流，承上之源而布。之者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甘節之吉，居位中也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619846671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619863055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣居尊位，又得中道，所以吉而有功。節以中爲貴，得中則正矣，正不能盡中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619863055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏曰：琰曰節貴乎中。當節而不節，則六三有不節之嗟；過於節，則上六有苦節之凶。惟九五甘節而吉者，蓋居位之中，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048607795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"位以節，無過無不及也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苦節貞凶，其道窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619879439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619895823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"節，旣苦而貞固守之，則凶。蓋節之道至於窮極矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619895823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吳氏曰：愼曰：爻言苦節，貞凶，彖言苦。節，不可貞。惟其貞凶，是以不可貞也。故彖、象傳皆以其道窮也釋之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤上有風。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619912207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619928591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以議獄緩死。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619944975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619961359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"風感水受，中孚之象。議獄緩死，中孚之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619961359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澤上有風，感於澤中，水體虛，故風能入之人心。虛，故物能感之。風之動乎澤，猶物之感於中，故爲中孚之象。君子觀其象以議獄與緩死。君子之於議獄，盡其忠而己於決死，極於惻而已，故誠意常求於緩。緩，寛也。於天下之事，无所不盡其忠，而議獄緩死最其大者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687470403610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619961359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊氏萬里曰：風無形而能鼓幽濳，誠無象而能感人物。中孚之感，莫大於好生不殺，議獄者求其入。中之出，緩死者，求其死中之生也。○項氏安世曰：獄之將決則議之，其旣決則又緩之，然後盡於人心，王聽之。司㓂聽之，三公聽之，議獄也，旬而職聽，二旬而職聽，三月而上之，緩死也。故獄成而孚，輸而孚，在我者盡，故在人者無憾也。○徐氏幾曰：象言刑獄五卦：噬嗑、豐，以其有離之明、震之威也。賁次噬嗑，旅次豐，離明不易震，皆反爲艮矣。蓋明貴無時不然，威則有時當止。至於中孚，則全體似離，互體有震、艮，而又兌以議之，巽以緩之，聖人卽象垂敎，其忠厚惻怛之意，見於謹刑如此。案風之入物也，不獨平地草木爲之披拂，巖谷竅穴爲之吹吁，卽積水重陰之下，亦因之而凍解氷釋焉。此所以爲至誠無所不入之象也。民之有獄，猶地之有重陰也。王者體察天下之情隱，至於議獄緩死，然後其至誠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460480547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無所不入矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初九虞吉，志未變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619977743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138619994127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"當信之始，志未有所存，而虞度所信，則得其正，是以吉也。蓋其志未有變動，志有所從，則是變動虞之，不得其正矣。在初言求所信之道也。案志未變，言其實心不失也。志變則有他矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其子和之，中心願也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620010511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620026895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中心願，謂誠意所。願也。故通而相應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620026895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱氏震曰：荀子所謂同焉者合類焉者，應也。○程氏敬承曰：鶴之鳴，由中而發，子之和，亦根心而應，故曰中心願。願出於中，乃孚之至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460513315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或鼓或罷，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620043279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620059663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居不當位，故无所主，唯所信是。從所處得正，則所信有方矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620059663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：六三，居不當位。心無所主，故或鼓或罷而不定。若初九則不如是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬匹亡，絶類上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620076047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620092431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絶其類而上從。五也。類，謂應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620092431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"：胡氏炳文曰：坤以喪朋爲有。慶中孚之四，以絶類爲无咎。○趙氏玉泉曰：馬匹亡者，四有柔正之德，故能絶初之黨類，而上以信於五也。案三與四皆卦所謂中虛者也，其居內以成中虛之象同，其得應而有匹敵者亦同。然三心繫於敵而四志絶。乎匹者，三不正而四正也。又六四承九五者多吉，六三應上九者多凶。易例如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687470419994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有孚攣如，位正當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620108815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620125199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五居君位之尊，由中正之道，能使天下信之，如拘攣之固，乃稱其位。人君之道，當如是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620125199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：以其正當尊位，故戒以繫信，乃得无咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翰音登于天，何可長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620141583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620157967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"守孚至於窮極而不知變豈可長久也，固守而不通，如是則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620157967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰虛聲無實，何可久長。○侯氏行果曰：窮上失位，信不由中，有聲無實，虛華外揚，是翰音登天也。虛音登天，何可久也。○胡氏瑗曰：上九徒以虛聲外飾，無純誠篤實之行，以此而往，愈久愈凶，故聖人戒之曰：何可長如此，蓋欲人改。過反，誠以信實爲本也。○項氏安世曰：上九，巽極而躁，不正不中，內不足而求孚於外，聲聞過情，其涸也可立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713861651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而待，愈久愈凶，何可長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山上有雷。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620174351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小過，君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620190735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620207119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山上有雷，其聲小過。三者之過，皆小者之過。可過於小，而不可過於大，可以小過，而不可甚過。彖所謂可小事宜下者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620223503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雷震於山上，其聲過常，故爲小過。天下之事，有時當過，而不可過甚，故爲小過。君子觀小過之象，事之宜過者則勉之，行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉是也。當過而過，乃其宜也，不當過。而過則過矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620223503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：小人過差，失在慢易奢侈，故君子矯之以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉也。○張子曰：過恭哀儉，皆宜下之義。○鼂氏說之曰：時有舉趾，高之莫敖，故正考父矯之以循牆，時有短喪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358611675168803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之宰予，故高柴矯之以泣血；時有三歸反玷之管仲，故晏子矯之以敝裘。雖非中行，亦足以矯時厲俗。○趙氏彦肅曰：恭、哀、儉多不及，過之而後中。〇楊氏啟新曰：過恭、過哀、過儉，此豈不爲高世絶俗之行而過乎人？但其所過者以收斂卑下爲過，故但可言小過，而不可言大過也。案雷出地，則聲方發達而大，及至山上，則聲漸收斂而微，故有平地風雷大作，而高山之上不覺者，此小過之。義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛鳥以凶，不可如何也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620239887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620256271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其過之疾，如飛鳥之迅，豈容救止也？凶，其宜矣，不可如何，无所用其力也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620256271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何氏楷曰：以凶。者，自納於凶也。孼由已作，可如何哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460578851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不及其君臣，不可過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620272655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620289039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所以不及君而還遇臣者，以臣不可過故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620289039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"過之時，事无不過其常故於上進則戒及。其君臣不可過，臣之分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620289039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏炳文曰：小者有時而可過，臣之於君，不可過也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從或戕之，凶如何也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620305423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620321807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陰過之時，必害於陽，小人道盛，必害君子，當過爲之防，防之不至，則爲其所戕矣，故曰凶如何也。言其甚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"弗過遇之，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620338191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"往厲必戒，終不可長也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620354575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620370959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"爻義未明，此亦當闕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620370959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"位不當謂處柔九四當過之時，不過剛而反居柔，乃得其宜，故曰遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460562467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之，遇其宜也。以九居四，位不當也；居柔乃遇其宜也。當陰過之時，陽退縮自保足矣，終豈能長而盛也？故往則有危，必當戒也。長，上聲作平聲，則大失易意。以夬與剝觀之，可見與夬之象文同而音異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620370959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"錢氏一本曰：三、四皆失位，故特明其位不當。三防四遇，亦皆宜下；三從或戕，四往必戒，亦皆不宜上。案位不當，卽所謂剛失位而不中者。惟剛失位而不中，故戒以當過遇之，不然則有危矣，豈可長執此而不知。變乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"密雲不雨，已上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620387343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620403727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"已上太高也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620403727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽降陰升，合則和而成雨。陰已在上，雲雖密，豈能成雨乎？陰過不能成大。之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620403727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龔氏煥曰：密雲不雨。小畜謂其尚往者，陰不足以畜陽，而陽尚往也。小過謂其已上者陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460595235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"過乎陽而陰已上也，一爲陽之過，一爲陰之過，皆陰陽不和之象，所以不能爲雨也。案：兩卦密雲不雨，龔氏謂皆陰陽不和之象，是已。然小畜所謂尚往者，亦是陰氣上行，與此爻已上同，非兩義。也。但小畜卦義，喻在下者則尚往者當積厚而自雨；此爻之義，喻在上者則己上者當下交而乃雨，意義不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爾弗遇，過之，已亢也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620420111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620436495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居過之終，弗遇於理而過。之，過已亢極，其凶宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620436495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏穎達曰：釋所以弗遇，過之以其。已在亢極之地故也。○趙氏汝楳曰：已上未爲極，已亢則極矣。〇俞氏琰曰：六五曰已上，謂其已過也。上六又過甚，故曰已亢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358640460611619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水在火上。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620452879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620469263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以思患而豫防之。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620485647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620502031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火旣交，各得其用，爲旣濟。時。當旣濟，唯慮患害之生，故思而豫防，使不至於患也。自古天下旣濟。而致禍亂者，蓋不能思患而豫防也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620502031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"王氏申子曰：旣濟雖非有患之時，患每生於旣濟之後，君子思此而豫防之，則可以保其初吉，而無終亂之憂矣。〇龔氏煥曰：水上火下，雖相爲用，然水決則火滅，火炎則水涸，相交之中，相害之機伏焉。故君子思患而豫防之。能防在乎豫，能豫在乎思。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曳其輪，義无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620518415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620534799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣濟之初，而能止其進，則不至於極，其義自无咎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620534799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"徐氏在漢曰：初當方濟之始，而曳其濟險之輪，控制在我，則義無不濟，此所以濡其尾而无咎，象故歸重於曳其輪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008469543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七日得，以中道也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620551183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620567567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中正之道，雖不爲時所用，然无終不行之理，故喪茀七日當復得，謂自守其中，異時必行也。不失其中則正矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620567567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何氏楷曰：二居下卦之中，以中感中，得其正應，故終必相孚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
