{"lines":[{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三年克之，憊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620583951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620600335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言憊以見其事之至難，在高宗爲之則可，无高宗之心，則貪忿以殃民也。案：言憊以見成功之非易，如人之疾病而以毒藥攻去之者，其元氣亦耗傷矣。苟無休養之方以復元氣，則又大病之根也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終日戒，有所疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620616719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048673331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620633103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"終日戒懼，常疑患之將至也。處旣濟之時，當畏愼如是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620633103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"李氏簡曰：終日戒，謂備患之心。無時可忘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620649487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實受其福，吉大來也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620665871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620682255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五之才德非不善，不如二之時也。二在下，有進之時，故中正而孚，則其吉大來，所謂受福也。吉大來。者，在旣濟之時爲大。朱氏震曰：盛不如薄者，時也來也，亨小、初吉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620682255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五，旣濟無所進，盈則當虛，故。曰：不如西鄰之禴祭。理無極而不反者，旣濟極矣，五以中正守之，能未至於反而已。〇王氏申子曰：言人君處旣濟，如未濟，而後有受福之實，不然，雖極其豐盛，而濟道衰矣。○張氏淸子曰：旣濟之後，唯恐過盛，以祭言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358619048656947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"於斯時也，豐不如約，故東鄰不如西鄰，牛不如禴。蓋祭而得其時，雖禴之薄，實足以受其福，而吉之大來可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濡其首，厲，何可久也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620698639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620715023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣濟之窮，危，至於濡首，其能長久乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620715023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"胡氏瑗曰：旣濟之終，反於未濟，至於濡没其首，故當翻然而警，惕然而改，何可久如此乎？案厲未至於凶，特可危爾，知其危而反之，則不至於濡首矣。凡易言何可長、何可久者，自屯上至此爻，皆惕以攺悟而不可迷溺之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火在水上。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620731407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620747791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子以愼辨物居方。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620764175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358639713894419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620780559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火異物，各居其所，故君子觀象而審辨之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620780559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水火不交，不相濟爲用，故爲未濟。火在水。上，非其處也。君子觀其處不當之象，以愼處於事物，辨其所當，各居其方，謂止於其所也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620780559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱氏震曰：火上水下，各居其所，未濟也。君子觀此，愼辨萬物。有辨然後有交，有未濟，乃有旣濟，而未濟含旣濟之象。○何氏楷曰：愼辨物者，物以羣分也；愼居方者，方以類聚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"濡其尾，亦不知極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620796943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620813327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"極字未詳，考上下韻亦不叶，或恐是敬字，今且闕之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳、","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620813327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不度其才力而進，至於濡尾，是不知。之極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620813327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張氏振淵曰：事必敬始，而後可善其用於終初，所以致尾之濡，不是時不可爲，心不知敬。愼故耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358687554011146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九二，貞吉，中以行正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620829711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620846095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九居二，本非正，以中故得正也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620846095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九二，得正而吉者，以曳輪而得中道，乃正也。案程子言正未必中，中無不正，故凡九二、六五皆非正也，而多言貞吉者，以其中也。惟此象傳釋義最明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620862479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"征凶，位不當也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620878863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620895247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二征則凶者，以位不當也，謂陰柔不中正，无濟險之才也。若能涉險以從應，則利矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620895247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吳氏。澄曰：未濟諸爻皆位不當，而獨於六三言之，以未濟由六三故也。○俞氏琰曰：六爻皆位不當，而獨於六三曰位不當，以六三才弱而處下體之上也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貞吉悔亡，志行也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620911631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358618008502311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620928015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如四之才與時合而加以貞固，則能行其志，吉而悔亡。鬼方之伐，貞之至也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620928015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俞氏琰曰：爻以六三爲未濟，則九四其濟矣，是以其志行也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子之光，其暉吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312138620944399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本義","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646926863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"暉者，光之散也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳、","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646926863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"光盛則有暉，暉，光之散也。君子積充而光盛，至於有暉，善之至也，故重云。吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646926863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"張氏振淵曰：光而言暉，昭其盛也。貞吉之吉，吉在五；暉吉之吉，吉在天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飮酒濡首，亦不知節也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646943247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"程傳","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646959631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"飮酒至於濡首，不知節之甚也。所以至如是，不能安義命也。能安則不失其常矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646959631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孔氏。穎達曰：釋飮酒所以致濡首之難，以其不知止節故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358654528127028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案旣濟之上，彖所謂終亂，未濟之上，則彖所謂汔濟者也。緣尾之象在初，故此不用濡尾之義，但戒以不可濡。首而失其節，則猶之不續終之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御纂周易折中卷第十二","logicSentenceId":"7679312139646976015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358654528176180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358985718792228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易大傳曰：河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366868003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔安國云：河圖者，伏羲氏王天下，龍馬出河，遂則其文以畫八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366884387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書者，禹治水時，神龜負文而列於背，有數至九，禹遂因而第之，以成九類。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366900771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366917155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱子荅袁樞曰：以河圖、洛書爲不足信，自歐陽公以來已有此說，然終無奈，顧命、繫辭、論語皆有是。言，而諸儒所傳二圖之數，雖有交互，而無乖戾，順數逆推，縱橫曲直，皆有明法，不可得而破除也。至如河圖與易之天一至地十者，合而載天地五十有五之數，則固易之所自出也。洛書與洪範之初一至次九者合而具。九疇之數，則固洪範之所自出也。繫辭雖不言伏羲受河圖以作易，然所謂仰觀俯察，遠求近取，安知河圖非其中一事邪？大抵聖人制作所由，初非一端，然其法象之規模，必有最親切處。如鴻荒之世，天地之閒，陰陽之氣雖各有象，然初未嘗有數也。至於河圖之出，然後五十有五之數，奇耦生成，粲然可見，此其所以深發聖人。之獨智，又非泛然氣象之所可得而擬也。是以仰觀俯察，遠求近取，至此而後兩儀、四象、八卦之陰陽奇耦可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358985718824996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得而言，雖繫辭所論聖人作易之由者非一，而不害其得此而後決也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劉歆云：伏羲氏繼天而王，受河圖而畫之，八卦是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366917155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禹治洪水，錫洛書法而陳之九疇是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366933539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖洛書相爲經緯，八卦九章，相爲表裏。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366949923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關子明云：河圖之文七，前六後，八左九右；洛書之文九，前一後三，左七右四，前左二，前右八，後左六後右。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366966307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366982691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱子書河圖、洛書曰：讀大戴禮書，又得一證甚明。其明堂篇有二九四七五三六一八之語，而鄭氏注云：法龜文也。然則漢人固以九數者爲洛書也。〇又偶讀漫記曰：子華子論河圖之二與四，抱九而上躋六。與八蹈一而下沈五居其中，據三持七，巧亦甚矣。惟其甚巧，所以知其非古書也。案：鄭注大戴禮是確證，至子華子則位置雖明，但錯以洛書爲河圖，故朱子疑其非古書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"邵子曰：圓者星也，歷紀之數，其肇於此乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366982691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歷法合二始","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366999075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359021139656731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以定剛柔，二中以定律歷，二終以紀閏餘，是所謂歷紀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233366999075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方者土也，畫州井地之法，其倣於此乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367015459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"州有九井九百畝，是所謂畫州井地也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367031843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋圓者河圖之數，方者洛書之文，故羲、文因之而造易，禹、箕敘之而作範也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367048227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡元定曰：古今傳記，自孔安國、劉向父子、班固皆以爲河圖授羲，洛書錫禹。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367064611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"關子明、邵康節皆以十爲河圖，九爲洛書。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367080995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋大傳旣陳天地五十有五之數，洪範又明言天乃錫禹洪範九疇，而九宮之數，戴九履一，左三右七，二四爲肩，六八爲足，正龜背之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367097379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟劉牧臆見，以九爲河圖，十爲洛書，託言出於希夷，旣與諸儒舊說不合，又引大傳以爲二者皆出於伏羲之世，其易置圖書，並無明驗。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367113763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358985718857764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但謂伏羲兼取圖書，則易、範之數，誠相表裏，爲可疑耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367130147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其實天地之理，一而已矣，雖時有古今先後之不同，而其理則不容於有二也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367146531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故伏羲但據河圖以作易，則不必豫見洛書，而己逆與之合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367162915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大禹但據洛書以作範。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233367179299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則亦不必追考河圖，而已暗與之符矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923399714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所以然者何哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923416098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誠以此理之外，無復他理故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923432482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然不特此爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923448866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"律吕有五聲十二律，而其相乗之數究於六十。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923465250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日名有十幹十二支，而其相乗之數亦究於六十二者，皆出於易之後，其起數又各不同，然與易之陰陽策數多少自相配合，皆爲六十者，無不合若符契也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923481634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下至運氣、參同、太乙之屬，雖不足道，然亦無不相通，蓋自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923498018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假令今世","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923514402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358940932177971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"復有圖書者出，其數亦必相符，可謂伏羲有取於今日而作易乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923514402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳所謂河出圖，洛出書，聖人則之者，亦汎言聖人作易作範，其原皆出於天之意。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923530786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如言以卜筮者尚其占與莫大乎蓍龜之類，易之書豈有龜與卜之法乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923547170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦言其理無二而已爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923563554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，天數五，地數五，五位相得而各有合。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923579938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天數二十有五，地數三十，凡天地之數五十有五，此所以成變化而行鬼神也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923596322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一節夫子所以發明河圖之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923612706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之閒，一氣而已，分而爲二，則爲陰陽，而五行造化，萬物始終，無不管","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923629090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358985718874148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於是焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923629090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故河圖之位，一與六共宗而居乎北，二與七爲朋而居乎南；三與八同道而居乎東；四與九爲友而居乎西，五與十相守而居乎中。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923645474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋其所以爲數者，不過一陰一陽，以兩其五行而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923661858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂天者，陽之輕清而位乎上者也；所謂地者，陰之重濁而位乎下者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923678242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數奇，故一、三、五、七、九皆屬乎天，所謂天數五也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923694626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰數耦，故二、四、六、八、十皆屬乎地，所謂地數五也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923711010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天數地數，各以類而相求，所謂五位之相得者然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923727394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天以一生水，而地以六成之；地以二生火，而天以七成之；天以三生木，而地以八成之；地以四生金，而天以九成之；天以五生土，而地以十成之，此又其所謂各有合焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923743778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積五奇而爲二","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923760162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358940932227123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十五，積五耦而爲三十，合是二者而爲五十有五，此河圖之全數，皆夫子之意而諸儒之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923760162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於洛書，則雖夫子之所未言，然其象其說已具於前，有以通之，則劉歆所謂經緯表裏者可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923776546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案中閒述大傳處，是夫子之意；天一生水之類，則是諸儒之說。蓋諸儒舊說皆以五行說圖書，故朱子於啓蒙。本義因而仍之。他日又曰：河圖、洛書於八卦九章不相著，未知如何也。然則朱子之意，蓋疑圖書之精緼不盡。於諸儒之所云者爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：河圖、洛書之位與數，其所以不同，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923792930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：河圖以五生數，統五成數，而同處其方，蓋揭其全以示人，而道其常數之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923809314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書以五奇數，統四耦數，而各居其所，蓋主於陽以統陰，而肇其變數之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923825698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358940932210739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923842082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"趙氏汝楳曰：一對二，三對四，而五居中。六七合一二，八九合三、四而十合五。奇耦胥對，陰陽有合，而數之體以立，聖人所謂陰陽合德而剛柔有體者，此其類也。體立矣，不變則數不行。故陽以三左行，陰以二右。行三其一爲三而居東，三其三爲九而居南，三其九爲二十七而七居西；三其二十七爲八十一而一復居北。等而上之，至於億兆，其餘數之位皆然。二其二爲四而居東南，二其四爲八而居東北，二其八爲十六而六居。西北二，其十六爲三十二，而二復居西南上，而億兆亦然。八位旣列，五仍居中，而數之，用以通聖人所謂參伍。以變錯綜其數者，此其類也。○鮑氏雲龍曰：以洛書變數推之，陽以三左行，天圓徑一圍三，三，天數也，一在北。一而三之，三在東，三其三爲九而居南，九而三之，三九二十七而居西，三其二十七爲八十一，而一復居於北。北而東，東而南，南而西，西而復北，循環不窮，有以符天道左旋之義。地方徑一圍四，兩其二也，蓋以地上之數。起於二，而陰資以爲始，位在西南而右行，二而二之爲四，而居東南，二而四之爲八，而居東北。二其八爲十六。而居西北，二其十六，爲三十二，而二復居西南。本位西南而東南，東南而東北，東北而西北，西北而復西南，亦循環不窮，有以協地道右行之說。一三九七，陽居四正，二四八六，陰居四隅，左右旋轉，相爲經緯，造化之妙如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359013946408960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此若以河圖推之亦然，但陰陽對布，内外交錯，有不同爾。案：朱子此條，已盡圖書之大義，蓋以生數統成數，而同處其方者，自五以前爲方生之數，自五以後爲旣成之數，陰生則陽成，陽生則陰成，陰陽二氣，相爲終始，而未嘗相離也。以奇數統耦數，而各居其所者，四正之位奇。數居之，四維之位，耦數居之。陰統於陽，地統於天，天地同流，而定分不易也。揭其全以示人，而道其常者數至。十而始全，缺一則不全矣。故曰數之體主於陽，以統陰而肇其變者，始於一，終於九，所以起因乗歸除之法。故曰：數之用，然生成之理則明矣。而正維之位所自定者，惟趙氏、鮑氏之說爲能推明其意，諸家皆不及也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：其皆以五居中者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923842082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：凡數之始，一陰一陽而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923858466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之象圓，圓者徑一而圍三；陰之象方，方者徑一而圍四。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923874850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圍三者以一爲一，故參其一陽而爲三；圍四者以二爲一，故兩其一陰而爲二，是所謂參天兩地者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923891234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三二之合則爲五矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923907618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此河圖、洛書之數，所以皆以五爲中","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923924002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358985718890532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923924002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案三二之合，五也，一四之合亦五也。一一二二之積又五也；三三四四之積，又五之積也。此五所以爲數之會。而位之中與。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然河圖以生數爲主，故其中之所以爲五者，亦具五生數之象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923940386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其下一㸃，天一之象也；其上一㸃，地二之象也；其左一點，天三之象也；其右一㸃，地四之象也；其中一點，天五之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923956770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書以奇數爲主，故其中之所以爲五者，亦具五奇數之象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923973154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其下一㸃亦天一之象也，其左一㸃亦天三之象也，其中一㸃亦天五之象也；其右一㸃則天七之象也，其上一㸃則天九之象也，其數與。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233923989538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位皆三同而二異，蓋陽不可易，而陰可易，成數雖陽，固","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924005922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359021139705883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦生之陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924005922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：中央之五，旣爲五數之象矣，然其爲數也奈何？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924022306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：以數言之，通乎一圖，由內及外，固各有積實可紀之數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924038690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然河圖之一、二、三、四各居其五，象本方之外，而六、七、八、九、十者，又各因五而得數，以附於其生數之外。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924055074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之一、三、七、九，亦各居其五，象本方之外，而二、四、六、八者，又各因其類，以附於奇數之側。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924071458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋中者爲主，而外者爲客，正者爲君，而側者爲臣，亦各有條而不紊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924087842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集説","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924104226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"翁氏泳曰：河圖東北陽方，則主之以奇而與合者耦；西南陰方，則主之以耦，而與合者奇。○吳氏曰：愼曰：陽始北而終西。一、三陽尚微，故居內；七九陽盛而著於外也。必實其中而後能著乎外，故五居中，陰始南。而終東。二、四陰尚微，故居內。六、八陰盛而凝於外也。必堅乎外而後能實其內，故十居中。自中而外，陽之生長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358997202698267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自外而中，陰之收藏，觀於草木之枝葉果實，亦可見矣。○五，生數之終，十成數之終，而藏於中，此太和之所以保合深固，而生機之所以充實於內也。案此段卽與上生數統成數、奇數統耦數一段相發明。以生數統成數者，生數常居內而爲主，成數常居外而爲客，如一歲之寒暑往來，一月之明𩲸死生，一日之晝夜進退，其自生而長者，皆爲主者也；其自盛而衰者，皆爲客者也，此河圖之大義也。以奇數統耦數者，奇數居四，正而爲君，耦數居四，側而爲臣，如天之以圓而運旋。則樞在四正，地之以方而奠位，則維在四隅。天尊而地卑之位也，陽主而陰輔之分也。此洛書之大義也。翁氏吳氏之論河圖，深得朱子內外賓主之意，其於洛書雖未及，然前文趙氏、鮑氏之說足以通之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：其多寡之不同何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924104226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：河圖主全，故極於十，而奇耦之位均，論其積實，然後見其耦贏而奇乏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924120610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書主變，故極於九，而其位與實皆奇贏而耦乏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924136994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必皆虛其中也，然後陰陽之數均於二十而無偏耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924153378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359013946474496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"案此段亦與上段數之體、數之用相發明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：其序之不同何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924169762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：河圖以生出之次言之，則始下次上，次左次右，以復於中，而又始於下也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924186146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以運行之次言之，則始東、次南、次中、次西、次北，左旋一周，而又始於東也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924202530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其生數之在内者，則陽居下左而陰居上右也；其成數之在外者，則陰居下左而陽居上右也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924218914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之次，其陽數則首北、次東、次中、次西、次南，其陰數則首西南，次東南，次西北、次東北也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924235298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而言之，則首北、次西南，次東、次東南，次中，次西北、次西、次東北，而究於南也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924251682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其運行則水克火，火克金，金克木，木克土，右旋一周，而土復克水也，是亦各有說矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924268066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：其七八九六之數不同何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924284450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359013946441728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：河圖六七八、九旣附於生數之外矣，此陰陽老少進退饒乏之正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924300834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其九者，生數一三五之積也，故自北而東，自東而西，以成於四之外；其六者，生數二四之積也，故自南而西，自西而北，以成於一之外。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924317218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七則九之自西而南者也，八則六之自北而東者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924333602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此又陰陽老少互藏其宅之變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924349986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之縱橫十五，而七八九六，迭爲消長，虛五分十，而一含九，二含八，三含七，四含六，則參伍錯綜，無適而不遇其合焉，此變化無窮之所以爲妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924366370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：然則聖人之則之也奈何？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924382754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：則河圖者虛其中，則洛書者總其實也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924399138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖之虛五與十者，太極也；奇數二十，耦數二十者，兩儀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924415522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以一二三四爲六七八九者，四象","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924431906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358965355479055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924431906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"析四方之合以爲乾坤離坎，補四隅之空以爲兌震巽艮者，八卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924448290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之實，其一爲五行，其二爲五事，其三爲八政，其四爲五紀，其五爲皇極，其六爲三德，其七爲稽疑，其八爲庶徵，其九爲福極，其位與數尤曉然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924464674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集說","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924481058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朱子語類云：洛書本文只四十五點，班固云：六十五字，皆洛書本文。古字畫少，恐或有模樣，但今無。所考漢儒此說未是，恐只是以義起之，不是數如此。蓋皆以天道、人事參互言之。五行最急，故第一五事又參。之，故第二。身旣脩，可推之於政，故八政次之。政旣成，又驗之於天道，故五紀次之。又繼之以皇極居五，蓋能推五行，正五事，用八政，脩五紀，乃可以建極也。六三德，乃是權衡此皇極者也。德旣脩矣，稽疑庶徵，繼之者，著其驗也，又繼之以福極，則善惡之效，至是不可加矣。皇極非大中也。皇乃天子，極乃極至，言皇建此極也。○呉氏曰：愼曰：河圖虛中宫以象太極，故周子曰：無極而太極。洛書主中五以爲皇極，故曰：皇建其有極。〇陰陽皆自内始生，窮外而盡。觀四時之寒暑相推，萬物之榮枯生死可見。河圖生數始於內，成數終於外，先天圓圖震一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359021139722267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽至乾三陽，巽一陰至坤三陰，皆自內而外，内者爲主而漸長，外者爲客而漸消，此法象之不可易者也。○洛書上三數象天，中三數象人，下三數象地。人能參天地，贊化育，建中和，故歸重於五皇極焉。案吳氏三條，於圖書卦疇深有發明，所謂無極有極云者，則易範之第一義也。其以先天圖合河圖，語尤眞切。聖人所謂則之者，爲其理之符契耳，豈必規規於點畫方位而求密合哉？洛書以四正之參數，象天四隅之兩。數象地，中宮之合數象人。吳氏分三重者，似亦本於大戴禮、子華子之說。然今以洪範考之，蓋始於一二三中。於四五六，終於七八九，而各以相天道，建主極，協民居，爲之先後次第，自日用飮食、脩己治人之近，層累增高。至於上下同流而後已焉。皆所謂得其理而不規規於㸃畫方位以求密合者。大抵易卦以八爲節，其根起於兩儀也。範疇以九爲節，其根起於三才也。知易範所起之根，則知圖書所縕之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：洛書而虛其中，則亦太極也；奇耦各居二十，則亦兩儀也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924481058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一二三四而含九八七六，縱橫十五而互爲七八九六，則亦四象也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924497442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四方之正，以爲乾坤離坎，四隅之偏，","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924513826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444358965355495439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以爲兌震巽艮，則亦八卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924513826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖之一六爲水，二七爲火，三八爲木，四九爲金，五十爲土，則固洪範之五行，而五十有五者，又九疇之子目也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924530210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是則洛書固可以爲易，而河圖亦可以爲範矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924546594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且又安知圖之不爲書，書之不爲圖也邪？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924562978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：是其時雖有先後，數雖有多寡，然其爲理則一而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924579362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但易乃伏羲之所先得乎圖，而初無所待於書、範，則大禹之所獨得乎書，而未必追考於圖耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924595746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且以河圖而虛十，則洛書四十有五之數也；虛五則大衍五十之數也；積五與十，則洛書縱橫十五之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924612130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以五乗十，以十乗五，則又皆大衍之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924628514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之五，又自含五而得十，而通爲大衍之數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924644898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積五與十，則得十五而通","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924661282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359013946458112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲河圖之數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924661282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟明乎此，則橫斜曲直無所不通，而河圖、洛書又豈有先後彼此之閒哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679315233924677666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"啓蒙附論","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707545138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子之作啓蒙，蓋因以象數言易者，多穿穴而不根，支離而無據。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707561522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然易之爲書，實以象數而作，又不可畧焉而不講也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707577906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且在當日，言圖書、卦畫、蓍數者，皆創爲異論，以毁成法，師其獨智而訾先賢。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707594290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故朱子述此篇以授學者，以爲欲知易之所以作者，於此可得其門戸矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707610674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今摭圖書、卦畫、蓍數之所包藴，其錯綜變化之妙，足以發朱子未盡之意者，凡數端，各爲圖表，而繫之以說。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707627058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋所以見圖書爲天地之文章，立卦生蓍爲聖神之制作，萬理於","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707643442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359093634203699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是乎根本，萬法於是乎權輿，斷非人力私智之所能參，而世之紛紛撰擬，屑屑疑辨，皆可以熄矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707643442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970741283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳言河圖曰一二，曰三四，曰五六，曰七八，曰九十，則是以兩相從也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707725362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大戴禮言洛書曰二九四，曰七五三，曰六一八，則是以三相從也。","logicSentenceId":"7679312908707741746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故原河圖之初，則有一便有二，有三便有四，至五而居中，有六便有七，有八便有九，至十而又居中，順而布之，以成五位者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511275034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原洛書之初，則有一二三，便有四五六，有四五六，便有七八九，層而列之，以成四方者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511291418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以陽動陰靜而論，則數起於上，故河圖之一二本在上也，三四本在右也，六七本在下也，八九本在左也；洛書之一二三四五、六七八九，本自上而下也，於是陽數動而交易，陰數靜而不遷，則成河圖、洛書之位矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511307802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如以陽靜陰動而論，則數起於下，故","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511324186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181352995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖之一二本在下也，三四本在左也，六七本在上也，八九本在右也；洛書之一二三四五、六七、八九，本自下而上也，於是陽數靜而不遷，陰數動而交易，則又成河圖、洛書之位矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511324186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋其以兩相從者，如有天則有地也，有君則有臣也，有夫則有婦也；以三相從者，如有天地則有人也，有君臣則有民也，有父母則有子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511340570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽動陰靜者，如乾君而坤藏也，君令而臣從也，夫行而婦順也，自上而下，以用而言者也；陽靜陰動者，如乾主而坤役也，君逸而臣勞也，父安居而妻子勤職也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511356954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自內而外，以體而言者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511373338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同本相從，以成合一之功，動靜相資，以播生成之化。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511389722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化人事之妙，窮於此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511406106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先後天圖象之精藴，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511422490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359106611413055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莫不於此乎出也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511422490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自洛書以三三積數爲數之原，而自四以下，皆以爲法。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511438874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511455258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511471642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三者天數也，故其象圓，如前圖居四方與居四隅者，或動或靜，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511488026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"居中者一定不易。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而各成縱横皆十五之數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511488026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四者，地數也，故其象方，如後圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511504410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居中居四隅與居四方者，或動或靜，亦各成縱橫皆三十四之數矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511520794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自五五以下，皆以三三圖爲根，自六六以下，皆以四四圖爲根，而四四圖又實以三三圖爲根。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511537178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故洛書爲數之原，不易之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511553562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今附四四圖如左，以相證明。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511569946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘具數學中，不悉載。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511586330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970774051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四八十二十六，四九五十六十二、八十二、一三七十一十五十四、七十一二三十六十五二、六十十四十五、六十三、二十一、七十四、一五九十三、一十二、八十三十六、五九四，此以十六數自左而右，自上而下列之，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511602714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第一圖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其居中與居四隅者不易，而居四方者交易，則成縱橫皆三十四之數，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511602714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第二圖：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居四方者不易，而居中與居四隅者交易。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511602714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦成縱橫皆三十四之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511619098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第三圖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十三九五一十三、八十二一四九五十六十四十六二、三十六十五十四、七十一、二十五十一、七三二十一、七十四十五、六十三十六十二八四十六、五九四、一十二、八十三。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511635482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以十六數自右而左，自下而上列之，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511651866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第一圖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用前法變","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511651866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970757667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兩圖，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511651866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第二圖，第三圖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竝得縱横皆三十四之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511651866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但其不易者卽前之交易者，而其交易者卽前之不易者，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511668250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此第二圖同前第三。圖此第三圖，同前第二圖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋亦陰陽互爲動靜之理云。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511668250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181369379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖加減之原。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511684634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一、用中兩率，三七相加爲十，以一減之，得九，以九減之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511701018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得一。若用一九相加，亦爲十以。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511701018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三減之得七，以七減之得三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153339858955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gdxq8/1-7444359153339858955_299457_9161057.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uP0N9sficiu%2FgdTVcIh6Lk1Yfmo%3D","pictureHeight":600,"pictureWidth":617,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gdxq8/1-7444359153339858955_299457_9161057.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lnOkLXsa4xvLhRxOmUrptHbHf50%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gdxq8/1-7444359153339858955_299457_9161057.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書乗除之原，一","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用中兩率，三九相乗，爲二十七，以一除之，得二十七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，以二十七除之，得一。若用一與二十七相乗，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三除之得九，以九除之得三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"中兩率四八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用相乗爲三十二，以二除之，得十六，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十六除之，得二。若用二與十六相乘，以四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"除之得八，以八除之得四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511750170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721636873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳曰：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511766554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之數，皆自少而多，多而復還於少，此加減之原也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511782938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：參天兩地而倚數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511799322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天數以三行，地數以二行，此乗除之原也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511815706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故河圖以一二爲數之體之始，洛書以三二爲數之用之始。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511832090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然洛書之用，始於參兩者，以參兩爲根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511848474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實則諸數循環，互爲其根，莫不寓乗除之法焉，而又皆以加減之法爲之本。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511864858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今推得洛書加減之法四，乗除之法十六，積方之法五，句股之法四，各爲圖表以明之如左：洛書加減四法：一用奇數，左旋相加，得相連之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511881242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359093634252851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一加三爲四，三加九爲十二，九加七爲十六，七加一爲八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用奇數，減左旋相連之耦數，得右旋相連之奇數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511881242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三減四爲一，九減十二爲三，七減十六爲九，一減八爲七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用耦數，左旋相加，得相連之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511897626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二加六爲八，六加八爲十四，八加四爲十二，四加二爲六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用耦數，減左旋相連之耦數，得右旋相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511897626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六減八爲二，八減十四爲六；四減十二爲八，二減六爲四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用奇數，右旋加耦數，得相連之奇數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511914010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一加六爲七，七加二爲九，九加四爲十，三，三加八爲十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511930394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用奇數，減相連之奇數，得相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511946778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一減七爲六，七減九爲二，九減十三爲四，三減十一爲八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359095668473875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用耦數，右旋加奇數，得相對之奇數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511963162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二加九爲十一，四加三爲七，八加一爲九，六加七爲十三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若用奇數，減相對之奇數，得相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511963162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九減十一爲二，三減七爲四，一減九爲八，七減十三爲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511979546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書乗除十六法：一用三，左旋乗奇數，得相連之奇數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511995930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三三如九，三九二十七，三七二十一，三一如三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用八，左旋乗耦數，得相連之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511995930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八八六十四，八四三十二，八二一十六，八六四十八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用三，左旋乗耦數，得相連之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511995930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三四一十二，三六一十八，三二如六，三八二十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153339908107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用八，左旋乗奇數，得相連之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511995930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八三二十四，八九七十二，八七五十六，八一如八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用二，右旋乗耦數，得相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320511995930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二二如四，二四如八，二八一十六，二六一十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用七，右旋乗奇數，得相連之奇數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512012314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七七四十九，七九六十三，七三二十一，七一如七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用二，右旋乗奇數，得隔二位之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512012314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二九一十八，二一如二二三如六，二七一十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用七，右旋乗耦數，得相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512012314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七二一十四，七四二十八，七八五十六，七六四十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用一乗奇數，得本位之奇數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512028698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359095668441107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一一如一，一三如三，一九如九，一七如七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用六乗耦數，得本位之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512028698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六六三十六，六四二十四。六八四十八，六二一十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用一乗耦數，得本位之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512028698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一二如二，一八如八，一四如四，一六如六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用六乗奇數，得相連之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512028698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"六七四十二，六九五十四。六三一十八，六一如六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用四乗耦數，得相對之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512045082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四四一十六，四六二十四，四二如八，四八三十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用九乗奇數，得相對之奇數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512045082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九九八十一，九一如九九三二十七，九七六十三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359172952703003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用四乗奇數，得隔二位之耦數；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512045082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四九三十六，四一如四。四七二十八，四三一十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一用九乗耦數，得相對之耦數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512045082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九二一十八，九八七十二；九四三十六，九六五十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡除法，除其所得之數，得其所乗之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512061466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書乗除十六法，可約爲八法。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512077850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512094234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五者，河洛之中數，自此以上，由五以生。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512110618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五加一爲六，六減五爲一，是六與一同根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512127002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五加二爲七，七減五爲二，是七與二同根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512143386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三八四九，其理如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512159770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今用三與八，左旋乗奇耦，而皆得相連之奇耦，可以知八卽三矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512176154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用二與七，右旋乘奇耦，而皆得相連之奇耦，可以知七卽二矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512192538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內惟二乗奇數，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512208922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359095668490259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得隔二位之耦數者，其所得卽相連奇位同根之數，猶之乎相連也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512208922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如二九一十八，八與三同根，得八，猶之得相連之三也。餘放此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用一與六乗，而皆得本位之奇耦，可以知六卽一矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512225306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"內惟六乗奇數，得相連之耦數者，其所得即本位同根之數，猶之乎本位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512241690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如六七四十二，七與二同根，得二，猶之得本位之七也。餘放此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用四與九乗，而皆得對位之奇耦，可以知九卽四矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512258074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内惟四乗奇數，得隔二位之耦數者，其所得卽對位同根之數，猶之乎對位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512274458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如四九三十六，六與一同，根得六，猶之得對位之一也。餘放此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其但得同根之數者何？","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512290842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"儿奇乗耦，耦乗耦，所得皆耦數而同。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512307226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三四一十二，八四亦三。十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇乘奇，其得數爲奇；若耦乗奇，不能得奇數而同，故但得其同根之耦數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512323610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三三爲九，八三二十四，九與四同根，得四，猶之得九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512339994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253534247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以一六二七、三八四九，在河圖則四方之相配，在洛書則正隅之相連，以其數之生於中五而同根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512339994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"數有合數，有對數。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512356378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合數生於五，對數成於十。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512372762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一六二七、三八四九，此合數也，皆相減而爲五者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512389146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一九二八、三七四六，此對數也，皆相併而爲十者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512405530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在河圖則合數同方而對數相連；在洛書則合數相連而對數相對。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512421914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相合之相從者，六從一也，七從二也，八從三也，九從四也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512438298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如前乗除十六法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相對之相從者，九從一也，八從二也，七從三也，六從四也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512454682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如後積方五法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡以合數共乗一數，所得之數必同，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512471066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乗耦旣同數，乘奇則同根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若各自乗焉，則又必合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512471066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三三得九，八八六十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以對數共乗一數，所得之數必對，","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512487450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三三得九，七三二十一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若各自","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512487450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359172952719387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乗焉，則又必同矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512487450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一一得一，九九亦八十一；二二得四，八八亦六十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以自乗之數，相合之相從者，此得自數，則彼亦得自數也；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512503834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一。得一，六得六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此得對數，則彼亦得對數也；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512503834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如四得六，九得一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此得連數，則彼亦得連數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512503834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三得九，八亦得四，二得四，七亦得九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相對之相從者，此得自數，則彼得對數也；","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512520218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如一得一，九亦得一，六得六四，亦得六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此得連數，則彼亦得連數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512520218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如三得九，七亦得九，二得四，八亦得四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要皆會於一六四九而齊焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512536602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故開平方之自乗數止於一六四九，而洛書之位，一六四九居上下以爲經，二七三八居左右以爲緯者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512552986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153339924491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書對位成十，互乗成百圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512569370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5geadc/1-7444359153339924491_93656_10431146.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3P8uI%2BNj7x6OVOChozZ6UZTLLA4%3D","pictureHeight":490,"pictureWidth":950,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5geadc/1-7444359153339924491_93656_10431146.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=o0mHh5yaNMG03B89GU0%2FlMfL1YM%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5geadc/1-7444359153339924491_93656_10431146.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一與九對成十","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512585754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十自乗，其積一百。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九，自乗八十一，一自乗一，一乗九，九乗一俱爲九，共十八，合之一百。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512585754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與十自乗積同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二與八對，成十八，自乗六十四，二自乗四，二乗八，八乗二，俱十六，共三十二，合之一百。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512602138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三與七對，成十七，自乗四十九，三自乗九，三乗七，七乗三，俱二十一，共四十二，合之一百。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512618522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四與六對，成十六，自乗二十六，四自乗十六，四乗六，六乗四，俱二十四，共四十八，合之一百。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512634906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中五含五成十五，自乗二十五，又五，自乗二十五，又五，互乗各二十五，共五十，合之一百。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512651290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"句三股四，弦五，句九股十二，弦十五，句二十七，股三十六，弦四十五，句八十一，股一百零八弦一百三十五。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512684058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北洛書四隅合中方而寓四句股之法者，推之至於無窮，法皆視此。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512700442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359173036310555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河洛未分未變方圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512716826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gfoxs/1-7444359173036310555_147648_9591493.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lj6gAi7x1Wgc89eWx2cpRGJt7p4%3D","pictureHeight":845,"pictureWidth":812,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gfoxs/1-7444359173036310555_147648_9591493.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pyFSpiWopewIuzB51%2B%2FZ8Ga6tJc%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gfoxs/1-7444359173036310555_147648_9591493.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721718793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖之數五十有五，洛書之數四十有五，合爲一百，此天地之全數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512733210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以一百之全數爲斜界，而中分之，則自一至十者，積數五十有五；自一至九者，積數四十有五。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512749594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者相交，而成河洛數之兩三角形矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512765978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡積數自少而多，必以三角而破百數之全方以爲三角，其形不離乎此二者，下諸圖之根實出於此。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512782362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181451299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河、洛未分未變三角圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512798746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gg1kw/1-7444359143181451299_111592_10051420.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LRzO9g3AUGfeop3Ef7de%2BGUp1lA%3D","pictureHeight":828,"pictureWidth":894,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gg1kw/1-7444359143181451299_111592_10051420.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=G7Vr%2F5ATQ%2FDA6orWcsF4JQFIuOs%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5gg1kw/1-7444359143181451299_111592_10051420.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153339973643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖之數自一至十，洛書之數，自一至九，象之已分者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512815130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖則生數居內，成數居外，書則奇數居正，耦數居偏，位之已變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512831514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如前圖破全方之百數以爲河、洛二數，又就點數十位中涵冪形之九層，以爲河、洛合一之數，則雖其象未分，其位未變，而陰陽相包之理，三極互根之道，已粲然默寓於其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512847898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故爲分析以明之如後。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512864282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512880666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181467683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸃數應河圖十位，周圍三角，分三重，中一重九，次，內一重二九一十八，外一重三九二十七，除中心凡五十四。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512880666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若自上而下，作三層，亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679313320512897050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冪形應洛書九位，周圍三角，分三重，中一重九次，內一重三九二十七，外一重五九四十五，凡八十一。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062038537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062054921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
