{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181500451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghg5c/1-7444359143181500451_264616_9071189.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BBNU0zGptPIcEgR9JDhvceq4TqM%3D","pictureHeight":573,"pictureWidth":643,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghg5c/1-7444359143181500451_264616_9071189.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=U55UKjg8oK%2BwhCirnrF0Xy3GbE0%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghg5c/1-7444359143181500451_264616_9071189.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中含六角，亦分三重，中一重六次，內一重三六一十八，外一重五六三十，凡五十四○若自上而下，作三層亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062087689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253567015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸圖，本同一根，雖積數若異，而其爲九六之變則一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062104073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九六可分爲內外中之三重，亦可分爲上下中之三層。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062120457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就每重每層論之，則九爲天而包地，六爲地而涵於天，心爲人而主乎天地。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062136841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"統三重而論之，則外爲天，內爲地，而中爲人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062153225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"統三層而論之，則上爲天，下爲地，而中爲人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062169609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又合而論之，則九六者，在天爲陰陽，在地爲柔剛，在人爲陰陽剛柔之會，而其心則天地人之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062185993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上下分者，其心有三，所謂三極之道，三才各具一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062202377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以內外分者，其心惟一，所謂人者，天地之心，三才統體一太極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062218761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此圖之中，渾具理象數之妙者如此，故分而爲圖，則應乎陰，陽剛柔之義，根於極而迭運不窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062235145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970872355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人則之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062251529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易有太極，是生兩儀，陽九陰六，命爻衍策者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062267913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分而爲書，則應乎三才之義，主於人而成位其中，聖人則之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062284297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極旣建，彞倫攸敘，參天貳地，垂範作疇者此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062300681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：河圖、洛書，出於兩時，分爲兩象，今以一圖括之，可乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062317065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：十中涵九，故數終於十，而位止於九，此天地自然之紀，而圖書所以相經緯而未嘗相離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062333449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"非有十者以爲之經，則九之體無以立；非有九者以爲之緯，則十之用無以行。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062349833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知圖書之本爲一者，則亦不知其所以二矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062366217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：河圖、洛書有定位矣，今以爲有未變者，何與？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062382601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：易大傳之言河圖也，曰：天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十，順而數之，此其未變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062398985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062415369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181533219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天數五，地數五，五位相得，而各有合，分而置之，此其定位者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062431753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如易卦一每生二，以至六十有四，則其未變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062448137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾南坤北，離東坎西，則其定位者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062464521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不知未變之根，則亦不足以識定位之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062480905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970855971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冪形爲算法之原，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062497289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghssg/1-7444359121970855971_94534_9931420.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=stqARkvByp0QxS9%2FBAeSjebglmo%3D","pictureHeight":886,"pictureWidth":899,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghssg/1-7444359121970855971_94534_9931420.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4Qhge%2BWwsVLBLNeufnPfncDDEOk%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3x5ghssg/1-7444359121970855971_94534_9931420.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153340022795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此圖左方注者，本數也，自一至九，而用數全矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062513673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中列注者，加數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062530057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一加二爲三，二加三爲五，至於八加九而爲十七，皆以本數遞加，而每層之冪積如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062546441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右方注者，乗數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062562825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一自乗一，其冪積，一二自乗四，其冪積，合一、三兩層而爲四。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062579209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於九自乗八十一，則其冪積亦合自一至十七、九層之數而爲八十一，皆以本數自乗，而每形之冪積如之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062595593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得加乗之法，則減除在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062611977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"自此而衍之，至於無窮，其數無不合焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062628361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推之九章之術，其理無不貫焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062644745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今考洛書，縱橫逆順，無往不得。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062661129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加減乗除之法，開方句股之算，乃自其未變之先，而諸法渾具，至洛書而始盡其參伍錯綜之致云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062677513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359143181565987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人爲天地心圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062743049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6tr1w/1-7444359143181565987_83529_10601890.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hde8gislbCJyHsgQnF9fMchP%2F7w%3D","pictureHeight":1361,"pictureWidth":977,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6tr1w/1-7444359143181565987_83529_10601890.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Idd%2F8A%2Bfcf8HFpNXJRVHJw%2F8src%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6tr1w/1-7444359143181565987_83529_10601890.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721767945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡有數則有象，象不離乎數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062759433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬象起於方圓，而測方圓者以三角，此句股所以爲算之宗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062775817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者天象，方者地象，三角形者，人象。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062792201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062808585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，如環無端，故其象圓也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062824969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地之道，奠定有常，故其象方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062841353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人受性於天，受形於地，猶三角之形，其心則圓之心，其邊則方之邊也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062857737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今就九數而三分之，則一者圓之根也，而十數之內，惟六角、八角爲有法之圓形，其自十以後，角愈多，以至於無角者，視此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062874121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此一、六八所以爲圓象之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062890505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者，方之根也，而十數之內，惟四與九，可以積成方面，其自十以後，積愈多而皆可成方者，視此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062906889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二四九所以爲方形之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062923273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以十數裁爲三角，自一至四，則三其心也；自一","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062939657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189797925"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至七，則五其心也；自一至十，則七其心也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062939657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂三角求心之法者如是，其自十以後，數愈多，而皆可以求心者視此矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062956041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三五七所以爲三角形之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062972425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之位，一六八居下，爲天道之下濟；二四九居上，爲地道之上行；三五七居中，爲人道之中處。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467062988809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其數其象，亦於圖形乎有合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063005193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189814309"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153340055563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先後天陰陽卦圖☳☲☱☰，陽先天。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063021577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"☴☵☶☷陰☰☳☵☶，陽後天。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063037961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"☷☴☲☱陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063054345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253632551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之陽卦曰震、離、兌、乾，其陰卦曰巽、坎、艮、坤，後天之陽卦曰乾、震坎艮，其陰卦曰坤、巽、離、兌，不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063070729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063087113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋先天分陰陽卦，自兩儀而分之，由陽儀以生者，皆陽卦也；由陰儀以生者，皆陰卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063103497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天分陰陽卦，自爻畫以定之，其以陽爲主者，皆陽卦也；其以陰爲主者，皆陰卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063119881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天則因乎畫卦之序而中分之，後天則卦之已成觀。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063136265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爻畫之多寡而命之也，其理如何？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063152649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：陽儀上有陰卦，此所謂立天之道，曰陰與陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063169033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰儀上有陽卦，此所謂立地之道，曰柔與剛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063185417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法象之自然者如何？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063201801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：火之炎熱光明，其爲陽也明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063218185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤者，水之積濕，爲陽氣所驅，以滋潤萬物者也，是亦陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063234569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之幽暗寒肅，其爲陰也","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063250953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253665319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063250953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山者，土之隆起，與地爲一體者也，是亦陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063267337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故先天之卦，陰陽之象之正也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063283721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其變而後天，則火與澤從風而俱爲陰，水與山從雷而俱爲陽，蓋有由矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063300105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陰陽之氣，未有不合而成者也，然有感應先後之别焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063316489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先有陽而遇陰者屬陽，先有陰而遇陽者屬陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063332873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陽氣在下，將發而遇陰壓之，則奮而爲雷矣；有陽氣在中，將散而遇陰包之，則鬱而爲雨矣；有陽氣直騰而上，而遇陰承之，則止而爲山矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063349257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆主於陽而遇陰，所以皆爲陽卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063365641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰在內，陽氣必入而散之，觀之陰霾盡而後風息可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063382025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰在中，陽氣必附而散之，觀之薪芻盡而後火滅可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063398409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有陰在外，陽氣必敷而散之，觀之濕潤盡","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063414793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253681703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而後澤竭可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063414793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆主於陰而遇陽，所以皆爲陰卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063431177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"總而論之，惟乾純陽，坤純陰，不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063447561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷，陽動之始，風陰生之始，亦不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063463945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火溫煖，澤發散，故以用言之則陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063480329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然火根於陰之燥，澤根於陰之濕，故以體言之則陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063496713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水寒涼，山凝固，故以用言之則陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063513097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然水根於陽之噓而流，山根於陽之矗而起，故以體言之則陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063529481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之象，著其用也，後天之象，探其根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063545865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正如仁之發生爲陽，而其柔和亦可以爲陰；義之收斂爲陰，而其剛決亦可以爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063562249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽本一氣而互根，故其理竝行而不悖也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063578633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721817097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天卦以天地水火爲體用圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063595017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6u3p0/1-7444359141721817097_79660_10101634.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Wa2WWzcJmgpXTmouCwzya7Cl3hE%3D","pictureHeight":974,"pictureWidth":931,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6u3p0/1-7444359141721817097_79660_10101634.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sB8zQVqfAKh5yg0uGmVQvgHv%2BsU%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6u3p0/1-7444359141721817097_79660_10101634.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721833481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"造化所以爲造化者，天地水火而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063611401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易卦雖有八，而實惟四。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063627785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467063644169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風卽天氣之吹噓而下交於地者也；山卽地形之隆起而上交於天者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326263347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷卽火之鬱於地中而搏擊奮發者也；澤卽水之聚於地上而布散滋潤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326279731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"道家言天地日月，釋氏言地水火風，西人言水火土氣，可見造化之不離乎四物也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326296115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故先天以南北爲經，而天地居之體也；以東西爲緯，而水火居之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326312499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天則以天地爲體而居四維，以水火爲用而居四正。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326328883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雷者火之方發，故動於春，及火播其氣，則王於夏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326345267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤者，水之未收，故散於秋，及水歸其根，則王於冬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326361651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火爲天地之用，故居四正以司時令也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326378035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天氣眹兆於西北，至東南而","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326394419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189879845"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下交於地，易所謂天下有風，姤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326394419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾、巽相對而爲天綱；地功致役於西南，至東北而上交於天，易所謂天在山中，大畜也，故坤、艮相對而爲地紀。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326410803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地爲水火之體，故居四維以運樞軸也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326427187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地水火體用互根，以生成萬物，此先後天之妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326443571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若以卦畫論之，則震卽離也，一陰閉之於上則爲震，兌卽坎也，一陽敷之於下則爲兌。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326459955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽卽乾也，一陰行於下則爲巽，艮卽坤也，一陽亘於上則爲艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326476339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以六十四卦始乾坤，中坎離，而終於旣、未濟，則知造化之道，天地水火盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326492723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153340071947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天卦變後天卦圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326509107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ugc4/1-7444359153340071947_91602_9801553.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kOxeXdsmW1jsfsJ0Gc1Pwt1xlv0%3D","pictureHeight":951,"pictureWidth":889,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ugc4/1-7444359153340071947_91602_9801553.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=LioyTxdS5c2bzJ0HEei%2FZdYZke4%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ugc4/1-7444359153340071947_91602_9801553.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253714471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此圖先天凡四變而爲後天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326525491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋火之體陰也，其用則陽而天用之，故乾中畫與坤交而變爲離。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326541875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水之體陽也，其用則陰而地用之，故坤中畫與乾交而變爲坎。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326558259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火在地中，陰氣自上壓之而奮出，則雷之動也，故離上畫與坎交而變爲震。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326574643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水聚地上，陽氣自下敷之而滋潤，則澤之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326591027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故坎下畫與離交而變爲兌。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326607411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽感於陰，則山出雲，是山者，雷與澤之上下相感者也，故震以上下畫與兌交而變爲艮。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326623795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰感於陽而水生風，是風者，澤與雷之上下相感者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326640179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故兌以上下畫與震交而變爲巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326656563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"風本天氣也，因與山交而入其下，則下與地接，故巽以上二爻與艮下二爻交而變爲坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326672947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山本地質也，因與風交而","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326689331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359121970921507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出其上，則上與天接，故艮以下二爻與巽上二爻交而變爲乾。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326689331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：此於經書有徵乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326705715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：在易天與火同人，是天以火爲用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326722099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水與地比，是地以水爲用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326738483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離爲火，亦爲電。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326754867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：雷電合而章，又曰：雷電皆至，是雷與火一氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326771251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澤有水則爲節，澤无水則爲困，是澤與水一物也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326787635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"周禮云：日西則多陰，蓋西方積山，故多雲雷，今之近嶂者皆然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326804019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：日東則多風，蓋東方積澤，故多風颶，今之濱海者皆然也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326820403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"莊周云：大塊噫氣，其名爲風，是風與地氣相接也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326836787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禮登山以祭，升中於天，是山與天氣相接也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326853171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天地水火者，一陰一陽而己，其情則交易而相通，其體則變易而無定。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326869555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故先天交變以成後天，莫不各得其","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326885939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189896229"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位而妙其化，各從其類而歸其根也，豈偶然哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326885939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189912613"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天卦配河圖之象圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326902323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359173346705408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖之左方陽內陰外，卽先天之震、離、兌乾，陽長而陰消也；其右方陰內陽外，卽先天之巽、坎、艮、坤，陰長而陽消也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326918707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋所以象二氣之交運也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326935091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253730855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天卦配河圖之象圖。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326951475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6v5mc/1-7444359152253730855_96698_9281614.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AFjcd6AHHHA3YSQElyxWkURmXW0%3D","pictureHeight":916,"pictureWidth":832,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6v5mc/1-7444359152253730855_96698_9281614.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Fisu80ih6nzflY3nqvkzWLoIUhs%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6v5mc/1-7444359152253730855_96698_9281614.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721866249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圖之一六爲水居北，卽後天之坎位也；三八爲木居東，卽後天震巽之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326967859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二七爲火居南，卽後天之離位也；四九爲金居西，卽後天兌乾之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467326984243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五十爲土居中，卽後天之坤艮，周流四季，而偏旺於丑未之交也，蓋所以象五行之順布也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327000627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153340137483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天卦配洛書之數圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327017011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vi9g/1-7444359153340137483_25773_7751571.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1GNeItVt%2FjskEzKK6aWCyM7atmM%3D","pictureHeight":798,"pictureWidth":750,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vi9g/1-7444359153340137483_25773_7751571.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sGZl%2FQDGYLrHrckgmL8oWudz%2FiM%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vi9g/1-7444359153340137483_25773_7751571.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385024552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直列洛書九數，而虛其中五，以配八卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327033395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇陽上陰下，故九數爲乾，一數爲坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327049779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因自九而逆數之，震八、坎七、艮六，乾生三陽也；又自一而順數之，巽二、離三、兌四，坤生三陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327066163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以八數與八卦相配，而先天之位合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327082547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385057320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天卦配洛書之數圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327098931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vuwk/1-7444359187385057320_64698_8291534.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zxX7o%2FBZP13D0XijlB1%2Bwe0hLUk%3D","pictureHeight":836,"pictureWidth":765,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vuwk/1-7444359187385057320_64698_8291534.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FGxFQIimAtdlI6MuXqSwugiO%2FMk%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6vuwk/1-7444359187385057320_64698_8291534.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385106472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火上水下，故九數爲離，一數爲坎。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327115315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火生燥土，故八次九而爲艮，燥土生金，故七六次八而爲兌爲乾；水生濕土，故二次一而爲坤；濕土生木，故三四次二而爲震、爲巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327131699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以八數與八卦相配，而後天之位合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327148083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之左邊本一、二、三、四也，其右邊本九八七六也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327164467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然陰陽之道，丑未之位必交，洛書之二與八，正東北西南之維，丑未之位，此其所以互易也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327180851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以此類之，則先天圖之左方坤巽離兌，其右方乾震坎、艮，以震、巽互而成先天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327197235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天圖之左方坎坤震巽，其右方離艮、兌乾，以艮、坤互而成後天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327213619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據先儒說，圖書出有先後，又或謂並出於伏羲之世，然","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327230003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359217189945381"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不必深辨。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327230003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先聖後聖，其揆一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327246387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"況天地之理，雖更萬年，豈不合契哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327262771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書晩出，而其理不妨已具於河圖之中，是故以易象推配，亦無往而不合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327279155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385073704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先後天卦生序卦雜卦圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327295539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6w7jo/1-7444359187385073704_210739_10021543.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0lyXf3uQKtXgCKVQX%2BQt9ZMUhTU%3D","pictureHeight":804,"pictureWidth":792,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6w7jo/1-7444359187385073704_210739_10021543.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=b%2Fs46ILOhUSKspHZ0tBfMhYOa78%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6w7jo/1-7444359187385073704_210739_10021543.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359153340153867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天圖者，序卦之根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327311923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"序卦之法，以兩卦相對爲義。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327328307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相對而翻覆不可變者，乾、坤、坎、離、頤、大過、中孚、小過是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327344691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相對而翻覆可變者，屯、蒙以後，旣未濟以前，五十六卦皆是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327361075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就五十六卦之中，則翻覆而二體不易者十二卦，需、訟、師、比、泰、否、同人、大有、晉、明夷、旣、未濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327377459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻覆而二體皆易者十二卦，隨、蠱、咸、恆、損、益、震、艮、漸、歸妹、巽、兌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327393843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其翻覆而止於一體易者三十二卦，則自屯、蒙至渙、節皆是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327410227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋翻覆而不可變者，法八卦之乾坤、坎離也；翻覆而可變者，法八卦之震艮、巽、兌也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327426611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就翻覆可變之中，其二體不易者，又皆乾坤坎離相交者也；其一體不易者，亦皆交於乾","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327442995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359173346754560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤坎離者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327442995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟震艮巽兌相交之卦，則二體皆易焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327459379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頤、中孚、大過、小過，雖爲震艮巽兌相交之卦，而翻覆不可變者，頤、中孚具離之象，大過、小過，具坎之象也，故序卦以之附於坎離，旣、未濟，爲其具離坎之象焉爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327475763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先天圖八卦兩兩相對，序卦之根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327492147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾與坤對，坎與離對，震與巽對，艮與兌對，相對而不相變，所以定序卦之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327508531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然旣相對，則必相交。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327524915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四正之卦相交，則雖翻覆而其體不易；四維之卦相交，則翻覆而其體遂易矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327541299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四正之卦與四維之卦雜交，則易者半，不易者半，所以極序卦之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327557683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故天地定位，上經所以始於乾坤，中於否、泰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327574067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山澤通氣，雷風相薄，下經所以始於咸、恆，中於","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327590451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631026239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"損、益也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327590451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水火不相射，上下經所以終於坎、離、旣、未濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327606835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385122856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮☶","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327623219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下去一陰，上生一陰，則爲坎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎☵","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327623219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下去一陰，上生一陰，則爲震。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震☳","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327623219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下去一陽，上生一陽，復爲艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾☰","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327623219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下去一陽，上生一陽，仍爲乾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"
