{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385139240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6wwtw/1-7444359187385139240_149633_10071497.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tnbH%2FDZH%2FZ3Q6BaUgZ33Ov0IeLE%3D","pictureHeight":864,"pictureWidth":858,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6wwtw/1-7444359187385139240_149633_10071497.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sBKDpZoShARDEMRsNUWimJr5aMw%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6wwtw/1-7444359187385139240_149633_10071497.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253780007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天圖者，雜卦之根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327655987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雜卦卽互卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327672371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互卦之法，或上去一畫而下生一畫，或下去一畫而上生一畫，則其體遂變矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327688755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"互體所成凡十六卦，其陽卦從陽卦，陰卦從陰卦者八，乾、坤、頤、大過、蹇、解、家人、睽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327705139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其陽卦交陰卦，陰卦交陽卦者亦八：剝、復、夬、姤、漸、歸妹、旣、未濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327721523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以交互之法求之，乾而上去一陽，下生一陽，或下去一陽，上生一陽，仍是乾矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327737907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤而上去一陰，下生一陰，或下去一陰，上生一陰，仍是坤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327754291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟震而上去一陰，下生一陰，則變爲坎，下去一陽，上生一陽，則變爲艮；巽而上去一陽，下生一陽，則變爲離；下去一陰，上生一陰，則變爲兌；坎而上去一陰，下生一陰，則","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327770675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631059007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變爲艮；下去一陰，上生一陰，則變爲震；離而上去一陽，下生一陽，則變爲兌，下去一陽，上生一陽，則變爲巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327770675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮而上去一陽，下生一陽，則變爲震，下去一陰，上生一陰，則變爲坎；兌而上去一陰，下生一陰，則變爲巽，下去一陽，上生一陽，則變爲離。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327787059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此八變者，皆陽得陽卦，陰得陰卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327803443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾之變則乾也，坤之變則坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327819827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震之變則雷水解也，山雷頤也；巽之變則風火家人也，澤風大過也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327836211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之變則水山蹇也，雷水解也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327852595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離之變則火澤睽也，風火家人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327868979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮之變則山雷頤也，水山蹇也；兌之變則澤風大過也，火澤睽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467327885363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皆因其能相變，故能相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422732314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乾而上去一陽，下生一隂，則變爲巽，下去一陽，上生一陰，則變","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422748698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660700710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲兌；坤而上去一陰，下生一陽，則變爲震，下去一陰，上生一陽，則變爲艮；震而上去一陰，下生一陽，則變爲兌；下去一陽，上生一陰，則變爲坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422748698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽而上去一陽，下生一陰，則變爲艮；下去一陰，上生一陽，則變爲乾。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422765082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎而上去一陰，下生一陽，或下去一陰，上生一陽，皆變爲離；離而上去一陽，下生一陰，或下去一陽，上生一陰，皆變爲坎。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422781466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮而上去一陽，下生一陰，則變爲坤，下去一陰，上生一陽，則變爲巽；兌而上去一陰，下生一陽，則變爲乾，下去一陽，上生一陰，則變爲震。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422797850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此八變者，皆陽得陰卦，陰得陽卦。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422814234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾之變則天風姤也，澤天夬也；坤之變則地雷復也，山地剝也；震之變則雷澤歸妹也，地雷復也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422830618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽之","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422847002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721915401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變則風山漸也，天風姤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422847002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之變則旣濟也、未濟也；離之變，則未濟也、旣濟也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422863386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮之變則山地剝也，風山漸也；兌之變，則澤天夬也，雷澤歸妹也，亦皆因其能相變，故能相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422879770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易互卦之法盡於此，此其卦所以止於十六也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422896154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天圖八卦，陰陽上下畫互變，雜卦之根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422912538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422928922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後天之卦，有各從其類以相變者焉，有各得其對以相變者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422945306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾居西北，而三陽從之，坤居西南，而三陰從之，此各從其類者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422961690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾與巽對，坎與離對，艮與坤對，震與兌對，此各得其對者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422978074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相從者，除乾坤純陽純陰不變外，坎而上去一陰，下生一陰，則爲艮；艮而上去一陽，下生一","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422994458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660717094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，則爲震；震而上去一陰，下生一陰，則復爲坎。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467422994458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三陽相次之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423010842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽而上去一陽，下生一陽，則爲離，離而上去一陽，下生一陽，則爲兌。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423027226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兌而上去一陰，下生一陰，則復爲巽。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423043610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三陰相次之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423059994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相對者，乾而上去一陽，下生一陰，則爲巽；坎而上去一陰，下生一陽則爲離；艮而上去一陽，下生一陰，則爲坤；震而上去一陰，下生一陽，則爲兌。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423076378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四陽卦變爲對位四陰卦之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423092762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽而下去一陰，上生一陽，則爲乾；離而下去一陽，上生一陰，則爲坎；坤而下去一陰，上生一陽，則爲艮，兌而下去一陽，上生一陰，則爲震。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423109146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此四陰卦變爲對位四陽卦之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423125530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然尋其對位相變之根，則又自父母男女長少而來。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423141914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋四","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423158298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660733478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦，兌爲最少，離爲中，巽爲長，坤爲老；四陽卦艮爲最少，坎爲中，震爲長，乾爲老。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423158298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡變者自少而老，故兌而上去一陰，下生一陽，則變爲乾矣；離而上去一陽，下生一陰，則變爲坎矣；巽而上去一陽，下生一陰，則變爲艮矣；坤而上去一陰，下生一陽，則變爲震矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423174682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四陽卦之變，自陰而來，故又變而爲對位之四陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423191066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"艮而下去一陰，上生一陽，則變爲巽矣；坎而下去一陰，上生一陽，則變爲離矣；震而下去一陽，上生一陰，則變爲坤矣；乾而下去一陽，上生一陰，則變爲兌矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423207450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四陰卦之變，自陽而來，故又變而爲對位之四陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423223834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合而觀之，凡陽卦相變者，震變坎，艮也，坎變震，艮也，艮","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423240218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631075391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又變震，坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423240218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陰卦相變者，巽變離，兌也，離變巽兌也，兌又變巽離也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423256602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽卦變陰卦者，乾變巽兌也，震變坤，兌也，坎變離也，艮變坤，巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423272986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陰卦變陽卦者，坤變震，艮也，巽變乾艮也，離變坎也，兌變乾震也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423289370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"易中所謂互卦者止於此，而其錯綜次序，皆具於後天也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423305754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253829159"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660749862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6x9h0/1-7444359245660749862_292532_9031093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=msbVcOlPyYf8mfV7mdmvEiKd19I%3D","pictureHeight":561,"pictureWidth":611,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6x9h0/1-7444359245660749862_292532_9031093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Jr%2FLNsNxqbhst8szbnYOkK4igiU%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6x9h0/1-7444359245660749862_292532_9031093.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍圓方之原，凡方圓可爲比例，惟徑七者，周二十八，周二十二，徑七，方周二十八，圓周二十二，卽兩積相比例之率也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423322138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"用其半，故若十。四與十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合二十八與二十二，共五十，是大衍之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423338522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"函方圓同徑兩周數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423354906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359152253845543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xm44/1-7444359152253845543_183477_9141158.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8PC0AdcyTafXWGmgNBTCkz86RcY%3D","pictureHeight":681,"pictureWidth":731,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xm44/1-7444359152253845543_183477_9141158.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2Fkad6HKP%2B0lDDXqWO%2F63VW3%2BAhY%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xm44/1-7444359152253845543_183477_9141158.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍句股之原，句三，其積九，股四，其積十六，弦五，其積二十五，合之五十。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423371290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是大衍之數，函句股、弦三面積，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423387674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359141721948169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍策之數，必以七爲用者，蓋方圓之形，惟以徑七爲率，則能得周圍之整數；句股之形，亦惟以三四爲率，則能得斜弦之整數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423387674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徑七固七也，句三股四之合亦七也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423404058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故論方圓周圍之合數則五十，論句股弦之合積亦五十，此大衍之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423420442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因而開方，則不盡一數，而止於四十九，此大衍之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423436826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"開方而不盡一數，則蓍策之虛一者是己。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423453210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方面之中，函八句股，而又不盡一數，則蓍策之掛一者是已。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423469594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟老陽老陰之數與此密合，故作圖以明之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423485978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385204776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xyr8/1-7444359187385204776_315605_8721156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hfIm6OpSBlWS71g7IFhegPE0dyY%3D","pictureHeight":551,"pictureWidth":557,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xyr8/1-7444359187385204776_315605_8721156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=v8N9QaNK0swzwgQOaSG2mMgXkeA%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6xyr8/1-7444359187385204776_315605_8721156.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老陽數合方法：全方四十九，中含大方六六三十六，爲過揲之數；小角一一如一，一六互乗爲十二，幷成十三，爲掛扐之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423502362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此與前洛書以自乗互乗爲積方之法同。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423518746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但洛書用對數，如一與九之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423535130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍用合數，則一與六是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423551514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184707082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ybec/1-7444359196184707082_403589_9491123.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hn5REbJ%2Bu2znvEk29WhJdGi8IOo%3D","pictureHeight":534,"pictureWidth":546,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ybec/1-7444359196184707082_403589_9491123.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RLs9VVRlCiAhXadXSIgAgZEzDWc%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6ybec/1-7444359196184707082_403589_9491123.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"老隂數合句股法，全方四十九，句三股四，其積六四因之，得二十四，爲過揲之數；弦五，其積二十五，爲掛扐之數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423567898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"弦實亦函四句股積，而多句股較一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十數之中，除一一不變，自二二至十十，皆可成方。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423584282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然惟三三則五數居其中，七七則二十五數居其中，此二者爲能得天地之中數，餘則不能也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423600666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋三三者，洛書之數","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423617050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359204162240551"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也；七七者，蓍策之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423617050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書之數五居其中矣，而其四方則又成四句股之數，而以中五爲弦之法焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423633434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍策之數，二十五居其中矣，而其四方則又具四句股之積，而卽以二十五爲弦之實焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423649818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是故卦數之八，合乎河圖之四也，爲其虛五十者同一根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423666202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍數之七，合乎洛書之三也，爲其用中五者同一根也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423682586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人因心之作，與天地自然之文，其相爲經緯者如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423698970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385253928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍迎日推策法，史稱黃帝迎日推策。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423715354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂策者，蓋卽神蓍也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423731738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推衍策數，以𠋫日月，故曰迎日推策。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423748122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"考之後代，譚卦畫者，多以曆法推配，然孔子未𠹉言也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423764506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟於大衍之數，則曰象四時、象閏，又曰當期之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423780890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則蓍策之與曆法相表裏也可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423797274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顧有以理言之而肖似者，有以數推之而密合者。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423813658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以理言而肖似者，孔子大傳所陳是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423830042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋四十九算排列成方，以句股之數求之，則零一者歸於中而爲心；以開方之法求之，則零一者歸於隅而爲角。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423846426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其歸於中也，故分二以象天地，而掛一者，象人之爲天地心也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423862810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以其歸於隅也，故分二以象二氣，而掛一者，象閏之爲一歲","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423879194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385237544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423879194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳所謂掛一以象三者，此零一之策也，所謂歸。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423895578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奇於扐以象閏者，亦此零一之策也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423911962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然當分二之初，此一之掛者，徒以象氣盈耳。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423928346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於每揲之後，又得餘策而扐之，然後以此掛一者歸之，而幷以象閏，則合氣盈朔虛而爲一者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423944730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以理言之，而大槩相似，是孔子之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423961114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於以數推之者，自黃帝之法不傳，至唐僧一行始以大衍命曆，以策數起歲分閏餘之算，然桉唐書曆志考之，其法蓋未密合也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423977498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故今以孔子之言爲宗，而參以一行之數、康節之理，據顓頊、周髀之制，以約畧千載坐致之術，爲法表以明之如左：一年三百六十五日，四分日之一，每日百分，凡三萬","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423993882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631140927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六千五百二十五分。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467423993882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以天數二十五除之，得一千四百六十一分，爲日數；又以地數三十除日數，得四十八零七分，爲月數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424010266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是爲大衍用數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424026650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳言蓍數，而以河圖之數首之，故一年全數以二十五除之，得日數者，日有曉、午、昏、夜，凡四限四分，期日爲一千四百六十一也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424043034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以三十除之，得月數者，月有朔、朢、上、下弦，凡四限四分，歲月","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424059418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"每月三十日算。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲四十八零七分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424059418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與大衍用數相應。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424075802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揲策合左右共四十八，應四十八弦，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"每弦七日半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲期日歲月之經數；","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇掛策一應氣盈之餘數，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"五日，四分日之一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇以初變爲主；","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184723466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日法十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"揲策應弦，每弦以十分爲率。○掛策應氣盈五日，四分日之一，於日法爲十分弦之七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"扐策合陰陽共十二，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"得少則四爲陽，得多則八爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應十二朔，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"每朔二十九日，九百。四十分日之四百九十九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲一歲之實數；","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三百五十四日九百四十分日之三百四十八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇掛策一應朔虛之餘數，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十日九百四十分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"，日之八百二十七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以初變爲主。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424092186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月法十九：○扐策應朔，每朔以十九分爲率。○掛策應朔，虛十日九百四十分日之八百二十七，於月法爲十。九分朔之七。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以初變之揲策、扐策計之，揲策四十八，以應四十八弦之整數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424108570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其掛一者，以應氣盈五日四分日之一也；扐策十二，以應十二朔之實數；其掛一者，以應朔虛十日八百二十七分也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424124954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"據四分曆法，每日九百四十分，故一歲之氣盈，有五日二百三十五分；一歲之朔虛，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424141338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此合氣盈總算。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424141338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359173346820096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十日八百二十七分。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424141338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毎弦七日四百七十分，如日法十分弦之七，則爲五日二百三十五分矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424157722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每朔二十九日四百九十九分，如月法十九分朔之七，則爲十日八百二十七分矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424174106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月毎日行十二度，十九分度之七，故以十九爲法日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月之法不同，而其餘分皆七。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424190490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故漢儒卦氣，每卦直六日，尚餘七分。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424206874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"毎卦。直六日七分者，日以八十分爲法也。蓋歲數三百六十五日，四分日之一，四乗而三除之，爲四百八十七，故四。百八十七者，歲策也。每卦直六日，六八四十八，得四百八十分，又餘七分，歲策之根也。積六十卦，直二百六十。日餘分之積，共四百二十分，以日法除之，爲五日四分日之一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"古今曆法一章之內有七閏月者，法由兹起也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424223258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其在蓍數，則何以見掛一之策爲餘七之算乎？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424239642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋亦以生蓍之法而知之爾。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424256026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦數八，八者體數也；蓍數七，七者用數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424272410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍以七爲用，而掛一者","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424288794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631157311"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用中之用，故其分數亦止於七也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424288794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆以一行之曆、康節之說參而用之者。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424305178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然一行以弦爲實弦，而不足七日有半；以掛一爲實閏，而其數又餘於一弦之外。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424321562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故今以弦爲七日半之經弦，以掛一爲五日四分日之一之盈分，必待扐餘之後，然後其歸奇之掛一，乃得應十日八百二十七分之數，而爲一歲之實閏也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424337946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似於大傳之先後次序，更爲𠯳合。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467424354330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過揲爲正策","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766665266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾策三十六，合六爻二百一十有六。坤策二十四，合六爻百四十有四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇凡三百有六十，當一期之日數；掛扐爲餘策，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766665266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乾策十三，合六爻七十八。坤策二十五，合六爻百五十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇凡二百二十有八，當一章之月數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766665266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正策以三十爲進退之法，故其合皆六十；餘策以十九爲進退之法，故其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184739850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"合皆三十八。三十者，日法也；十九者，朔法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二篇之策爲全策，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766681650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陽爻百九十一，得六千九百一十二。陰爻百九十二，得四千六百零八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇凡萬有一千五百二十，當閏終之總數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766681650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此因大傳之說而推備之者。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766698034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲者，正數也，太陽主之；閏者，餘數也，太陰主之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766714418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故堯典始而殷正四時，則曰日中日永日短，此以太陽爲主者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766730802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終則曰以閏月定四時成歲，此以太陰爲主者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766747186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍策之正數三百有六十，當一期之日，蓋日周天而爲一期，故爲太陽所主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766763570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘數二百二十有八，當一章之月，蓋氣朔分齊而爲一章，故爲太陰所主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766779954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其全數萬有一千五百二十，當閏終之總數。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766796338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋三十二月而閏一月，其辰萬有一千五百二","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766812722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359173346836480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十；三十二年而閏一年，其日萬有一千五百二十。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766812722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此則日月正餘、會終、蓍卦齊同之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766829106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歷代之曆，歲分消長不同，故有五日四分日之一而有餘者，亦有五日四分日之一而不足者。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766845490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然舉其中者以該其變者，則四分爲常法，故顓頊曆、周髀經皆用之，而司馬遷曆書述焉，蓋古法也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766861874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631190079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6yo1g/1-7444359195631190079_68665_10701708.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8u%2FuozchI8jtlbwroTV6Z4a5y3w%3D","pictureHeight":1043,"pictureWidth":1002,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6yo1g/1-7444359195631190079_68665_10701708.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mMvMAfai05zTmMzrQ0wAZ47vbjM%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6yo1g/1-7444359195631190079_68665_10701708.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾策、坤策圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766878258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165169664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以地平線分周天之度爲二，各一百八十度。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766878258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日出入朦景，昏旦各十八度，共三十六度。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766894642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以加晝景一百八十度，合二百一十有六，則乾之策之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766911026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以減夜漏一百八十度，餘一百四十有四，則坤之策之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766927410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大傳曰：乾坤之策，凡三百有六十，當期之日。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766943794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故各一百八十者，寒暑晝夜並行之體數也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766960178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然陽生而陰殺，陽明而陰暗，故陽饒而陰乏，陽盈而陰虛。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766976562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今以晝夜平分推之，其自然之數如此。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467766992946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一歲寒暑之𠋫，則若邵子之說，開物於寅末，是亦先十八日也；閉物於戌初，是亦後十八日也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767009330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以故萬物之數萬有一千五百二十，其從陽者六千九百一十二，其從陰者四千六百八。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767025714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣常盛則","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767042098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359187385335848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲豐年，善類常多則爲治世，其消息盈虛之理，亦若是而已矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767042098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660782630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359204162306087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6z0ok/1-7444359204162306087_147638_9351409.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8ZDpryT4Gii666MHORwN8YChaoU%3D","pictureHeight":771,"pictureWidth":788,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6z0ok/1-7444359204162306087_147638_9351409.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=PcR7YYASBnwv46Lg3SJH8shiuI0%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6z0ok/1-7444359204162306087_147638_9351409.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加倍變法圖","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767058482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631222847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此圖用加一倍法，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767074866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如第二層兩一生第三層中位之二，併左右兩一成四，是倍二爲四也。第三層一、二各生第四層中位之三，倂左右，兩一成八，是倍四爲八也。下放此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出於數學中謂之開方求廉率。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767074866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以左一爲方，右一爲隅，而中閒之數則其廉法也，","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767091250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"第三層爲平方，第四層爲立方，第五層、六層、七層爲三乗、四乗、五乗方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於成卦之理，亦相肖合。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767091250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767107634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽大陰小，陽如方，陰如隅，分居兩端，陰陽合則生中閒之兩象，如平方之方隅，合而生兩廉，其長如方，其廣如隅也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767124018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乗則生中閒之六卦，如立方之方隅，合而生六廉。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767140402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三平廉根於方，而其厚如隅；三長廉根於隅，而其長如方也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767156786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故開方之法，雖相乗，至於無窮，莫下依方隅以立算。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767173170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成卦之法，雖相加，至於無窮，莫不根陰陽以定體。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767189554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"成卦之始，一陰一陽，每每相","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767205938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165202432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加而已。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767205938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及卦成而分析觀之，則自一畫至六畫，惟純陰純陽者常不動，其餘則方。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767222322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲四象也，中閒一陰一陽者二，方。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767238706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其爲八卦也，中閒一陰二陽者三，一陽二陰者三，方其爲四畫也，中閒一陰三陽者四，一陽三陰者四，二陰二陽者六，方其爲五畫也，中閒一陰四陽者五，一陽四陰者五，二陰三陽者十，二陽三陰者十。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767255090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及其六畫之旣成也，中閒一陰五陽者六，一陽五陰者六，二陰四陽者十五，二陽四陰者十五，三陰三陽者二十。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767271474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子卦變之圖，以此而定也。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767287858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋其倍法同於畫卦，而其多寡錯綜之數，則卦變用之。","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767304242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165186048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御纂周易折中卷第二十一","logicSentenceId":"7679314467767320626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165218816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"御纂周易折中卷第二十二","logicSentenceId":"7679305957756108834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"序卦雜卦明義","logicSentenceId":"7679305957756125218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之序也、雜也，皆出於文王也。","logicSentenceId":"7679305957756141602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其所以序之雜之，必有深意，亦必有略例。","logicSentenceId":"7679305957756157986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至夫子爲之傳，乃因其次第而發明陰陽相生相對之義，以見易道之無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776452136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋文王之立法至精，而夫子之見理至大，二者皆不可以不知也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776468520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"韓、孔諸儒疑卦序若如夫子所言，則不應卦皆反對，故程傳於卦下旣述夫子之意，又爲上下篇義，以繹其未盡之指。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776484904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至歐陽脩諸人，直斥序卦爲非孔子之書者，妄也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776501288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜卦，則乾坤之後，繼以比、師，其次敘又與序卦無一同","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776517672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359204162322471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，是豈無義存焉，而諸儒皆莫之及。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776517672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟元儒胡氏於篇終微發其端，未竟其緒也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776534056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今因程、胡之說，而詳推二篇之所以類序錯綜者，目曰明義以附焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776550440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359204162355239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"序卦","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776566824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"程子有上下篇義，今祖其意而詳推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上篇陽也，天道也，故凡天道之正。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776583208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卦陽爻之盛，及陰陽長少先後有序者，皆上篇之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776599592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下篇陰也，人事也，故凡人事之交。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776615976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦陰爻之盛，及陰陽交感雜亂、長少先後無序者，皆下篇之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776632360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故以八卦而論，乾、坤陰陽之純也，坎、離陰陽之中也，皆正中之正，故爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776648744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震、巽陰陽始交也，艮、兌交之極也，皆正中之交，故爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776665128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以八卦之交而論，惟否、泰天地之交，交中之正也，故爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776681512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸、恆、損、益、旣、未濟，六子之交，交中之交也，故爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776697896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乾交陽卦凡六，需、訟、无妄、大畜皆爲陽盛，惟以爻畫參之，則大壯爲陽過中，遯爲陰浸長，故雖陽卦而居陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776714280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤交陰","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776730664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660848166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卦凡六：晉、明夷、萃、升皆爲陰盛，惟臨則陽浸長，觀則陰過中，故雖陰卦而居陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776730664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又乾交陰卦凡六：小畜、履同。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776747048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人、大有，皆五陽而一陰，陽之盛也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776763432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟以爻畫參之，則夬爲陽已亢，姤爲陰始生，故不得爲陽而爲陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776779816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤交陽卦凡六，師、比、謙、豫、剝、復，皆五陰而一陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776796200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽有主陰之義，陰雖多，不爲盛而爲役，陽雖少，不爲衰而爲主，故皆不爲陰而爲陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776812584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又陽卦相交凡六，屯、蒙、頤，長少先後以序者也，故爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776828968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇、解、小過，失序者也，故爲陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776845352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又陰卦相交凡六，獨大過爲頤之對，又得其序，故亦爲陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776861736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家人、睽、革、鼎、中孚，皆陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776878120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"革、鼎得序，故猶爲陰中之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776894504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又陰陽相交之卦凡十有二，其得序者六，隨、蠱、噬嗑、賁爲","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776910888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359195631239231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽中之陰；井、困爲陰中之陽；其失序者六，漸、歸妹、豐、旅、渙、節，陰中之陰也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776910888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二篇之分旣定，其逐節逐卦次第先後，則以陰陽盛衰消長之義次之如後。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776927272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論乾、坤、屯、蒙、需、訟、師、比、小畜、履，右陽卦第一節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776943656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泰、否、同人、大有、謙、豫，右陽卦第二節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776960040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨、蠱、臨、觀、噬嗑、賁、剝、復，右陽卦第三節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776976424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"无妄、大畜、頤、大過、坎、離，右陽卦第四節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580776992808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660864550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"咸、恆、遯、大壯、晉、明夷、家人、睽、蹇、解，右陰卦第一節；損、益、夬、姤、萃、升，右陰卦第二節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777009192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困、井、革、鼎、震、艮、漸、歸妹、豐、旅、巽、兌，右陰卦第三節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777025576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渙、節、中孚、小過、旣濟、未濟，右陰卦第四節，陽卦第一節。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777041960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤者衆卦之宗，故居篇首。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777058344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先儒謂周易首乾，則此是文王所定，不可易也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777074728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤之外，三男爲尊，屯、蒙者，三男","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777091112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184821770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之卦也，而皆長少先後，不失其序，得陽道之正，故次乾、坤焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777091112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"需、訟上下皆陽卦，二五皆陽爻，陽之盛也，故次屯、蒙焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777107496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"師、比皆以一陽爲衆陰主，而居二五中位，亦陽之。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777123880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盛也，故次需、訟焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777140264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小畜、履，五陽一陰，陽旣極多，而二陰又退居三、四之偏位，皆陽盛之卦也，故次師、比焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777156648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卦第二節泰、否者，乾坤之合體，義同乾坤者也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777173032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以其乾坤之交，故亞於乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777189416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同人、大有，義反師、比。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777205800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然以其陽多極盛，故同小畜、履而亞於師、比。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777222184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謙、豫，義反小畜、履。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777238568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然陽爲卦主，故同師、比而亞於小畜、履。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777254952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六者並爲陽盛之次也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777271336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卦第三節","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777287720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184838154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上二節，除屯、蒙爲三男純卦，餘則皆有乾坤爲主，未嘗有男女之交也，故曰陽盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777287720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至隨、蠱、噬嗑、賁，然後有男女之交，是陰始生也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777304104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而長少先後皆不失序，故猶爲陽中之陰。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777320488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隨、蠱之後，繼以臨、觀、噬嗑、賁之後，繼以剝、復，則陽又盛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777336872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽卦第四節无妄、大畜，乾與陽卦合體，義同需、訟，然二五不皆陽爻，故亞於需、訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777353256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頤、大過，男女類分，長少先後，義同屯、蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777369640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然二卦不皆陽卦，故亞於屯、蒙。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777386024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、離得天地之中氣，義同乾坤，然六子之卦也，故又亞於乾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777402408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此六卦者，顚倒與篇首六卦相對，並爲陽復盛之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777418792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184854538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦第一節下篇主人事之交，故以夫婦之道始。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777435176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女之合，少則情專，老則誼篤，故咸爲首，恆次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777451560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遯、大壯，陰長陽過，陰之盛也，故次咸、恆。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777467944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"晉、明夷。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777484328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上下皆陰卦，二五皆陰爻，義反陽之。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777500712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"需、訟。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777517096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家人、睽，三陰之卦也，而又長少失序，陰道也，義反陽之屯、蒙，故四卦次遯、大壯。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777533480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇、解，本三陽之卦，而亦長少失序，義反屯、蒙，故從家人、睽焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777549864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦第二節損、益二少二長之交，義同咸、恆。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777566248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夬、姤，陽極陰生，義同遯、大壯、萃、升，坤與陰卦交，義同晉、明夷。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777582632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故六卦相繼，陰盛之次也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777599016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359204162404391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦第三節困、井，男女交而以序義同陽之隨、蠱、噬嗑、賁，陰中之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777615400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"革、鼎三陰之卦，同家人、睽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777631784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然長少以序，故從困、井，猶大過之從頤也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777648168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"震、艮雖下經之主，然本陽卦也，故此六卦並爲陰中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777664552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漸、歸妹、豐、旅，男女交而失序，與困、井、革、鼎反。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777680936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巽、兌陰卦，與震、艮反，此六卦則又自陽而向乎陰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777697320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陰卦第四節漸、歸妹、豐、旅、渙、節六卦，男女交而失序，相類也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777713704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然漸、歸妹兩卦，長男長女皆在焉，豐、旅有長男在焉，渙、節惟長女在焉，則渙、節者，變之窮，陰道之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777730088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中孚、小過，與上","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777746472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359245660880934"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"篇頤、大過相對。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777746472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大過雖陰卦，以得其序而從頤，故小過雖陽卦，以失其序而從中孚。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777762856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其義與蹇、解之從家人、睽者同，並爲陰復盛之卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777779240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟、未濟終篇，所重在未濟。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777795624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋三陽失位，男之窮也，陰盛之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777812008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然物不可窮也，故受之以未濟終焉。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777828392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359196184870922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165333504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"序卦圓圖","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777844776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":" ","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6zdbo/1-7444359231165333504_85672_11661759.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MmLxnudimmDwl4IgkuCfD2F77us%3D","pictureHeight":1087,"pictureWidth":1081,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6zdbo/1-7444359231165333504_85672_11661759.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-png.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=j%2FATzUojluJa%2Bzy660sM6ezV0KM%3D","uri":"read/HY2301/18/ref/1l2lt3xn6zdbo/1-7444359231165333504_85672_11661759.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7444359231165349888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子繫辭傳敘上下篇九卦曰：履，德之基也；謙，德之柄也；復，德之本也；恆，德之固也；損，德之脩也；益，德之裕也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777861160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困，德之辨也；井，德之地也；巽，德之制也。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777877544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先儒以其卦推配上下經，皆相對。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777893928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋乾與咸、恆對，履與損、益對，謙與困、井對，復與巽、兌對。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777910312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"每以下篇兩卦對上篇一卦，凡十二卦，而二篇之數適齊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777926696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然十二卦之中，又止取九卦者，乾、咸其始也，兌其終也，略其終始，而取其中閒之卦，以著陰陽消息盛衰之漸，故止於九。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777943080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"〇前所推上下篇各四節，陰陽消息盛衰之次，與此圖密合。","logicSentenceId":"7679306580777959464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
